sa: द्रौपद्युवाच नावमन्ये न गर्हे चधर्मं पार्थ कथंचन। ईश्वरं कुत एवाहमवमस्ये प्रजापतिम्॥
en: Draupadi said : I never disregard or speak ill of religion, O son of Pritha; why should I disregard God, the lord of creations?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विसृज्य गन्धर्वं कृतकृत्यं शुचिस्मिता। उर्वशी चाकरोत् स्नानं पार्थदर्शनलालसा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having sent away the Gandharva successful (in his mission), the smiling Urvashi, moved by the desire of possessing Partha (Arjuna), bathed.

sa: इमाञ्छकुनकान् राजन् हन्ति वैतंसिको यथा। एतद् रूपमधर्मस्य भूतेषु हि विहिंसता॥ कामाल्लोभाच्चधर्मस्य प्रकृति यो न पश्यति। स बध्यः सर्वभूतानां प्रेत्य चेह च दुर्मतिः॥
en: O king, as a fowler kills the birds, so does sin kill all the creatures of the world. He who, being misled by pleasure and covetousness, does not understand the nature of virtue, deserves to be killed by all. He becomes a wretch here and hereafter (after death).

sa: सा भुर्ज भीमनिर्हादा भित्त्वा भीमस्य दक्षिणम्। साग्निज्वाला महारौद्रा पपात सहसा भुवि॥
en: And that tremendous (club) emitting flames and sending forth dreadful roars pierced suddenly the right arm of Bhima and then fell to the ground.

sa: अगस्त्येन विना को हि शक्तोऽन्योऽर्णवशोषणे। अन्यथा हि न शक्यास्ते विना सागरशोषणम्॥
en: Except Agastya, who else is capable of drying up the ocean? Without drying up the ocean, they cannot be assailed by any other ineans.

sa: हतेऽश्मवर्षे च मया जलवर्षे च शोषिते। मुमुचुर्दानवा मायामग्निं वायुं च भारत॥
en: The showers of stones being destroyed and the watery shower dried up by me, O Bharata, the Danavas created illusions of fire and wind.

sa: भ्रमन्तं तत्र तत्रैव देवेन विनिवारितम्। भ्रातृस्तान् ह्रियतो दृष्ट्वा द्रौपदी च महाबलः॥
en: Was going round in different directions through bewilderment caused by Destiny. Seeing his brothers and Draupadi thus being carried off, the greatly powerful (Bhima).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आदावेवाथ तं शक्रश्चित्रसेनं रहोऽब्रवीत्। पार्थस्य चक्षुरुर्वश्यां सक्तं विज्ञाय वासवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : One day Vasava (Indra), knowing that the glances of Partha were cast on Urvashi, called Chitrasena, spoke to him in private.

sa: कर्णस्तु तद्वाक्यमतीव हृष्टः सम्पूजयामास हसन् सशब्दम्। गान्धारराजः सुबलस्य पुत्र स्तथैव दुःशासनमभ्यनन्दत्॥
en: At these words, Karna became vary glad and approved them by laughing aloud. The Gandhara king, the son of Subala (Shakuni), similarly applauded Dushasana.

sa: अथवा ते ग्रहीष्यन्ति पुनरेष्यन्ति वा पुरम्। निरस्य समयं सर्वे पणोऽस्माकं भविष्यति॥
en: If however they accept thein (the words of your father) and again come to the city, violating their vow, this will be our conduct.

sa: अस्मिन् समागमे केन देवनं मे भविष्यति। प्रतिपाणश्च कोऽन्योऽस्ति ततो द्यूतं प्रवर्तताम्॥
en: In this assembly with whom am I to play? Who is there who can stake equally with me? Let the play begin (with him).

sa: तस्य पादौ सुरा राजन्नभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च। अयाचन्त वरं सर्वं यथोक्तं परमेष्ठिना॥
en: O king, bowing at his feet and saluting him, the celestials all together asked from him for the boon as directed by Parameshti (Brahma).

sa: मां च भीराविशत् तीव्रा तस्मिन् विगतचेतसि। स च मां विगतज्ञानः संत्रस्तमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: (And), when he lost his senses, I also was seized with a terrible fear. And (thus stupefied) he said to me in a hurry,

sa: न त्वेतत् सहसा पार्थ मोक्तव्यं पुरुषे क्वचित्। जगद् विनाशयेत् सर्वमल्पतेजसि पातितम्॥
en: O Partha, this weapon should not be discharged without proper reason, for if discharged at a weak enemy, it would destroy the whole universe.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच कथं त्वेवं वदसि प्रातिकामिन् को हि दीव्येद् भार्यया राजपुत्रः। मूढो राजा द्यूतमदेन मत्तो ह्यभूनान्यत् कैतवमस्य किंचित्॥
en: Duryodhana said O Pratikamin, why do you say so? Is there any prince who plays staking his (own) wife? The king was certainly intoxicated with dice, or else could he not find any other object or stake?

sa: न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किञ्चिदतीतानागतं भुवि। तस्मादिमं परिक्लेशं त्वं तात हृदि मा कृथाः।।२७।
en: Therefore, O child, do not be aggrieved by your this present calamily. There is nothing past of future that is not known to you.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तूर्णं प्रत्यानयस्वैतान् कामं व्यध्वगतानपि। आगच्छन्तु पुन तमिदं कुर्वन्तु पाण्डवाः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Then bring back the Pandavas, even if they have gone a great way off. Let them come and throw dice once again.

sa: तत्रामृतरसं शीतं लघु कुन्तीसुतः शुभम्। ददर्श विमलं तोयं पिबंश्च बहु पाण्डवः॥
en: The son of Kunti saw that ambrosial lake; its water was cool, light, clear and fresh. The Pandava (Bhima) drank much of its water.

sa: भीष्मकं च महावीर्यं दन्तवनं च भूमिपम्। भगदत्तं यूपकेतुं जयत्सेनं च मागधम्॥
en: Passing over the greatly energetic Bhishmaka, and the king Dantavakra, and also Bhagadatta celebrated for his many sacrificial stakes, the king of Magadha Jayacsena.

sa: अंशुमानेवमुक्तस्तु सगरेण महात्मना। जगाम दुःखात् तं देशं यत्र वै दारिता मही॥
en: Lomasha said: Having been thus addressed by the illustrious Sagara, Anshumana went to the place where the earth had been excavated (by his uncles).

sa: वासांसि च शुभान्यस्मै प्रददू राजशासनात्। तथागतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Other handsome and dry clothes were soon given to him at the command of the king (Yudhishthira). Seeing his this plight the mighty Bhimasena.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ताम्रलोहैः परिवृता निधयो ये चतुःशताः। पञ्चद्रौणिक एकैकः सुवर्णस्याहतस्य वै॥ जातरूपस्य मुख्यस्य अनर्धेयस्य भारत। एतद् राजन् मम धनं तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have four hundred Nidhis (very valuable jewels) encased in sheets of copper and iron; each one of them is equal to five Draunikas of the costliest and purest gold leaf of the Jatarupa kind. With this wealth, o king, I shall (now) stake with you.

sa: लोमश उवाच तानुवाच समेतांस्तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। गच्छध्वं विबुधाः सर्वे यथाकामं यथेप्सितम्॥
en: Lomasha said: The Grandsire of creatures Brahma thus spoke to the assembly (of celestials) “O gods, go wherever you like and desire to go.

sa: स भवान् परमं वेद पावनं पुरुषं प्रति। तेन संयोजयेथास्त्वं तीर्थपुण्येन पाण्डवान्॥
en: You know the great means by which men are purified. Therefore, persuade the Pandavas to acquire the virtue which is obtained by visiting Tirthas.

sa: तस्य चापि भवेत् कार्यं विवृद्धौ रक्षणे तथा। भक्ष्यमाणो ह्यनादानात् क्षीयेत् हिमवानपि॥
en: One should act either for increasing or protecting his wealth; if spent without being earned it vanishes although it be like (the mount) Himavana.

sa: यथा भागीरथो राजा राजानश्च गयादयः। यथा ययातिः कौन्तेय तथा त्वमपि पाण्डव॥
en: O son of Pandu and O Yudhishthira, you are like the king Bhagiratha or king Gaya or Yayati or any one else like them,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उपातिष्ठत सा सूर्यं मुहूर्तमबला ततः। स तस्यास्तनुमध्यायाः सर्वं सूर्योऽवबुद्धवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then that helpless one worshipped the sungod for a moment and the deity understood all the prayers of her of slender waist.

sa: अमर्षी नित्यसंरब्धो भीमः प्रहरतां वरः। मया तात प्रतीपानि कुर्वन् पूर्वं विमानितः॥
en: That wrathful Bhima, who is ever furiousthat chief among the smiters has by acting against my wishes, O dear, before been insulted by me.

sa: यद्येतदेवं जानासि न च मामभिशङ्कसे। आर्यां मतिं समास्थाय शाम्य भारत पाण्डवैः॥
en: If you know it to be so and do not suspect to mistrust me then adopting a virtuous resolution effect peace with the Pandavas.

sa: यत्र देवो महादेवो यत्र विष्णुः सनातनः। यत्र धर्मश्च यज्ञश्च तत्रेयं निवसेदिति॥
en: Where resides the lord Mahadeva, where resides the eternal Vishnu and where there are virtue and sacrificial ceremonies, so that she might live there.

sa: गुणकेशीति विख्याता नाम्ना सा देवरूपिणी। श्रिया च वपुषा चैव स्त्रियोऽन्याः साऽतिरिच्यते॥
en: She, having celestial beauty, was well known by the name of Gunakeshi and she greatly excelled all women in beauty, physical development and symmetry.

sa: पर्यागतं मम कृष्णस्य चैव यो मन्यते कलहं सम्प्रसह्य। शक्यं हर्तुं पाण्डवानां ममत्वं तद् वेदिता संयुगं तत्र गत्वा॥
en: He, however, who desires to get our Krishna on his side after creating disunion between us will know how far he can take away the affection of Krishna for us, aiter going to the field of battle.

sa: विदुर उवाच अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। आत्रेयस्य च संवाद साध्यानां चेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: Vidura said In this connection is quoted the old story of the conversation between the son of Atri and Saddhyas as heard by us.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विराटो नृपतिः सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः॥ श्रुत्वा स विजयं तस्य कुमारस्यामितौजसः।
en: Hearing of the victory of his son of immeasurable energy, the king Virata was greatly delighted, and the hairs of his body stood up.

sa: एवं तस्यै वरं दत्त्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान्। निवर्तयित्वा सावित्रीं स्वमेव भवनं ययौ॥
en: Having conferred these boons on her and having thus made her retrace her steps, the lord of justice (Yama) returned to his own abode.

sa: नारद उवाच तमाह विनतासूनुरारोह स्वेति वै द्विजम्। आरुरोहाथ स मुनिर्गरुडं गालवस्तदा॥
en: Narada said The son of Vinata said to the twice-born one get you up on me and then the Muni Galava rode on Garuda.

sa: सा मया सह संगम्य पुनः कन्या भविष्यसि। पुत्रश्च ते महाबाहुर्भविष्यति महायशाः॥
en: You will also remain a virgin even after having held intercourse with me and your son will be of mighty arms and high renown.

sa: अत्र सूर्यं प्रणयिन प्रतिगृह्णाति पर्वतः। अस्तो नाम यतः संध्या पश्चिमा प्रतिसर्पति॥
en: Here does the mountain named Asta receive the sun as if in love owing to which the evening twilight vanishes away in the west.

sa: पश्चिमा वारुणी दिक् च धार्यते व सुभद्रया। महानुभावया नित्यं मातले विश्वरूपया।॥
en: The western point, under the protection of Varuna, is supported by Subhadra who is ever of a great nature and of a universal foam.

sa: अत्र दत्तानि सूर्येण यजूंषि द्विजसत्तम। अत्र लब्धवरः सोमः सुरैः क्रतुषु पीयते॥
en: Here were given Surya the hymn of the Yajurveda, O best among the twice-born and here was drunk the Soma juice, previously sacrificial ceremonies.

sa: यदि ते रोचते सम्यग् भुजगोत्तम मा चिरम्। क्रियतामार्यक क्षिप्रं बुद्धिः कन्यापरिग्रहे॥
en: If this suits you, O best of the serpents, then without delay, O Aryaka, make the necessary arrangement for the acceptance of his daughter.

sa: एकेन तेन वीरेण षड् रथा: परिनिर्जिताः। शार्दूलेनेव मत्तेन यथा वनचरा मृगाः॥
en: Those six great Kuru car-warriors were defeated by that hero alone, as animals, ranging in the forest, are killed by a single angry tiger."

sa: ततः स भगवांस्तस्य स्कन्धे बाहुं समासजत्। निपपात स भारा” विह्वलो नष्टचेतनः॥
en: Then did that prosperous being place his arm on his shoulder. He fell down struck by the lord stupefied and deprived of his senses.

sa: यच्च मामात्थ देव त्वं पाण्डवं फाल्गुनं प्रति॥ व्येतु संतापजं दुःखं तव भास्कर मानसम्। अर्जुनप्रतिमं चैव विजेष्यामि रणेऽर्जुनम्॥
en: As to what you have said to me about the Pandava Falguna. O author light, (I ask you) to dispel your caused by mental uneasiness regarding Arjuna and myself. (Because) I will surely defeat Arjuna in battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथेतिवादिनं मत्स्यं कौरवेयाः पृथक् पृथक्। ऊचुः प्राढालयः सर्वे युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Those Kauravas, headed by Yudhishthira, with folded heads, said each severally to the king of the Matsya who had addressed them thus.

sa: प्रत्यक्षधर्मा भगवान् यस्य तुष्टो हि कर्मभिः। सफलं तस्य जन्माहं मन्ये सद्धर्मचारिणः॥
en: O exalted one, I consider the life of that virtuous man as having borne fruits with whose acts the supreme one himself is well-pleased.

sa: तथा तमुच्छधर्माणं दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमम्। उपतस्थे यथाकालं षट्कृत्वः कृतनिश्चयः॥ न चास्य मनसा कंचिद् विकारं ददृशे मुनिः। शुद्ध सत्त्वस्य शुद्धं स ददृशे निर्मलं मनः॥
en: In ths way Durvasa during successive seasons came for several times before that best of sages living according to the Unccha mode of life. But that rishi could not perceive any senses agitation in the heart of Mudgala. He found the heart of that virtuous-minded Rishi always pure.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच निष्कल्मषं तपस्त्वेतत् केवलं परिचक्षते। एतत् समृद्धमप्युद्धं तपो भवति केवलम्॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said Asceticism unstained by faults (desire, insufficient concentration etc.) alone leads to emancipation; this (asceticism) is successful; other sorts of devotion are unsuccessful.

sa: अहो दानं विधुष्टं ते सुमहत् स्वर्गवासिभिः। सशरीरो भवान् गन्ता स्वर्ग सुचरितव्रत॥
en: Even the dwellers of heaven are proclaiming your great deeds of charity. O vow-observing Rishi, you shall go to heaven in your own body.

sa: वारणा यत्र सौवर्णाः पृष्ठे भासन्ति दंशिताः। सुपार्श्व सुग्रहं चैव कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this most excellent bow of good sides and easy hold, on the staff of which shine golden elephants with such a brilliance?

sa: तमेवंवादिनमृषिदेवदूतमुवाच हा इच्छामि भवता प्रोक्तान् गुणान् स्वर्गनिवासिनाम्॥ के गुणास्तत्र वसतां किं तपः कश्च निश्चयः। स्वर्गे तत्र सुखं किं च दोषो वा देवदूतक॥
en: When the celestial messenger was thus talking, the Rishi told him, O celestial messenger, I desire that you should describe to methe attributes of those that live there. What is their asceticism and what is their purpose? What is the happiness in heaven and what are its defects?

sa: संजय उवाच अतीव मुदितो राजन् युद्धप्रेप्सुर्युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनार्जुनौ चोभौ यमावपि न बिभ्यतः॥
en: Sanjaya said Yudhishthira, desirous of war, is extremely cheerful; and the two, Bhimasena and Arjuna, are not otherwise. The twins too, are not afraid.

sa: कीचके तु हते राजा विराटः परवीरहा। परां सम्भावनां चक्रे कुन्तीपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: After the death of Kichaka, the powerful king Virata, the slayer of hostile heroes, began to form great expectations of the sons of Kunti.

sa: संजय उवाच धृष्टद्युम्नः सदैवैतान् संदीपयति भारत। युद्ध्यध्वमिति मा भैष्ट युद्धाद् भरतसत्तमाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Dhritarashtra is ever inciting them, O Bharata, saying, “Fight and do not fear a fight, you best among the race of Bharata.

sa: ऋषयोऽथ ततोऽभ्येत्य वृत्रमूचुः प्रियं वचः। व्याप्तं जगदिदं सर्वं तेजसा तव दुर्जय॥
en: Then the Rishis came there and said these conciliatory words of Vritra. O you hard to conquer, this world is pervaded by your energy.

sa: भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं कर्णं द्रौणि शल्यं सुयोधनम्। एतांश्चापि निरोत्स्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna, the son of Drona, Shalya and Suyodhana-these I will opposed like the shore, resisting the flow of the swelling waters.

sa: दुःशासनश्चित्रसेन: शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥ दुर्मुखो दुःसहः कर्ण उलूकोऽथ विविंशतिः। कुरुराजं पुरस्कृत्य दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥ विविशुस्तां सभां राजन् सुराः शक्रसदो यथा।
en: As also did Dushasana, Shakuni and Saubala. Durmukha, Dussaha, Karna, Uluka, Vivingshati having placed Duryodhana, the wrathful king of the Kurus, in the front, entered that Council, O king, like the gods forming the train of Shakra.

sa: येषु सम्प्रतितिष्ठेयुः कुरवः पीडिताः परैः। ते युद्धं नाभिनन्दन्ति तत् तुभ्यं तातरोचताम्॥
en: Those on whom depend the Kurus, when troubled by the enemy not rejoice at the prospect of war; O dear, may you accept that.

sa: गच्छध्वमृषिभिः सार्धं गन्धर्वैश्च सुरोत्तमाः। वृत्रस्य सह शक्रेण सन्धिं कुरुत मा चिरम्॥
en: O you best among the gods, go in company with the Rishis and the Gandharvas. Effect a truce without delay between Shakra and Vritra.

sa: बलं वीर्यं च तेजश्च शीघ्रता लघुहस्तता। अविषादश्च धैर्यं च पार्थान्नान्यत्र विद्यते॥
en: Strength, heroism, prowess, agility, lightness of hand, untiring energy and patience are centered in the son of Pritha and are not present anywhere else.

sa: रसाः स्पर्शाश्च गन्धाश्च शब्दाश्चापि गुणान्विताः। दृश्यानि च प्रसन्नानि यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Where the king Yudhishthira lives the objects of taste, touch, smell and hearing are all of excellent quality and the views are all delightful.

sa: अयाचं भ्रातृदारेषु तदा व्यासं महामुनिम्। सह मात्रा महाराज प्रसाद्य तमृषिं तदा॥
en: I begged the great Muni Vyasa, along with my mother, O great king, after having gratified that Rishi, with the wives of my brother,

sa: यत् ते कार्यं महाभाग क्रियतां तदनन्तरम्। सम्पूज्याप्सरसः शक्रो विसृज्य च महामतिः॥
en: O you with great parts, do what you should after this. The great-minded Shakra, having greeted the nymphs with due honours, sent them away

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच चिन्तयामास विदुरस्तमृषि शंसितव्रतम्। स च तच्चिन्तितं ज्ञात्वां दर्शयामास भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Vidura think of that Rishi of rigid austerities; he, too, becoming aware of that thought showed himself then, O Bharata.

sa: एवमेतत् करिष्यामि यथा तात त्वमात्थ माम्। यच्चान्यदपिशक्ष्यामि तत् करिष्यामि ते प्रियम्॥
en: O son, I shall do what you have told me and I shall do any thing more can I which is for your good.

sa: आसीत् प्रहर्ता सैन्यानां दारामर्शी च दुर्मतिः। स हतः खलु पापात्मा गन्धर्वैर्दुष्टपूरुषः॥
en: The wicked-minded Kichaka was the oppressor of men and the ravisher of soldier's wives; that vicious, wicked man has been slain by the Gandharvas.

sa: ब्रूहि संजय यच्छेषं वासुदेवादनन्तरम्। यदर्जुन उवाच त्वां परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: Tell me, O Sanjaya, the remaining part, after the speech of Vasudeva, viz., what Arjuna said to you. I have great curiosity for it.

sa: एतद् रामस्य ते जन्म सीतायाश्च प्रकीर्तितम्। रावणस्यापि ते जन्म व्याख्यास्यामि जनेश्वर।॥
en: I have thus recounted to you the birth of Rama and Sita; O lord of men, I shall now describe the birth of Ravana.

sa: पुलस्त्यो नाम तस्यासीन्मानसो दयितः सुतः। तस्य वैश्रवणो नाम गवि पुत्रोऽभवत् प्रभुः॥
en: Prajapati had a favourite son born of his mind by name Pulastya; and he had a powerful son begotten of cow by name Vaishravana.

sa: नरकं शम्बरं चैव कंसं चैद्यं च माधवः। जितवान् घोरसंकाशान् क्रीडन्निव महाबलः॥
en: That descendant of Madhu, of great strength, as if in play, conquered Naraka, Shambara, Kansa and the king of the Chedis in terrific battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पञ्चाधिकं शतं तच्च निहतं तेन भारत। महावनमिवच्छिन्नं शिश्ये विगलितगुमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O descendant of Bharata, thus there were slain hundred and five of them (as if) a huge forest over-spread with uprooted trees.

sa: कथं पुरुषशार्दूल शत्रुमध्ये विषीदसि॥ अहं वै कुरुभिर्योत्स्ये विजेष्यामि च ते पशून्।
en: Why are you pulled down in the midst of enemies O foremost of men? I shall fight with the Kurus and release your animals.

sa: प्रवारणं तु बालानां पूर्वं कार्यमिति श्रुतिः। तस्मात् प्रवारणं पूर्वमर्हः पार्थो धनंजयः॥
en: But the holy books lay down that the younger persons should be aided first, therefore I should first assist Dhananjaya, the son of Pritha.

sa: इदं च त्वां सर्वपरं ब्रवीमि पुण्यं पदं तात महाविशिष्टम्। न जातु कामान भयान्न लोभाद् धर्मं जह्याज्जीवितस्यापि हेतोः॥
en: I now speak of another sacred lesson, O sire, superior in sacredness to all these, fraught with a large meaning. Virtue should not be forsaken out of desire, fear, temptation, nor for the sake of life itself.

sa: अद्य कैकेयि दौर्भाग्यं राज्ञा ते ख्यापितं महत्। आशीविषस्त्वां संक्रुद्धश्चण्डो दशतु दुर्भगे॥
en: O Kaikeyi, your great ill-luck has today been proclaimed by the king. O unfortunate one, may a fierce and angry venomous snake bite you.

sa: तदिदं मयि ते दृष्टं प्रत्यक्षं मधुसूदन यथा राज्यात् परिभ्रष्टो वसामि वसतीरिमाः॥
en: All this has been seen by you in me, o slayer of Madhu, namely, how I have lived these years, deprived of our kingdom.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तत्र नर्मसंयुक्तमकरोत् पाण्डवो बहु। उत्तरायाः प्रमुखतः सर्वं जाननरिंदमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Although knowing everything, that slayer of foes, the son of Pandu, as if to make a fun, committed many mistakes before Uttara.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तमर्थमपि जल्पन्त्याः कृष्णायाः कीचकेन ह। दिवसाधु समभवन्मासेनैव समं नृप॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, thinking of the conversation she had with Kichaka, that half day appeared to Krishna as long as a whole month.

sa: तत्र मां धर्मराजस्तु कटाक्षेण न्यवारयत्। तदहं तस्य विज्ञाय स्थित एवास्मि भामिनि॥
en: But the lord of justice forbade me by a glance, O beautiful one; knowing his intention I desisted from the purpose and kept quiet.

sa: अयं च ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् मम राजन् पुरोहितः। प्रेष्यतां धृतराष्ट्राय वाक्यमस्मै प्रदीयताम्॥
en: This Brahmin, O king, who is my priest, is a wise man, send him to Dhritarashtra and tell him what he is to say.

sa: अहं तु सर्वलोकस्य गत्वा छेत्स्यामि संशयम्। येषामस्ति द्विधाभावो राजन् दुर्योधनं प्रति॥
en: I, too, going there, shall remove the doubts of all men, who are of one opinion and now of another regarding Duryodhana, O king.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु सा देवी बाष्पमुत्सृज्य सस्वनम्। उवाच रुदती दीना बृहस्पतिमिदं वचः॥
en: The goddess being thus spoken to, became depressed and sobbed aloud with tears in her eyes and then crying said these words to Brihaspati.

sa: भ्रातृभिः श्वशुरैः पुत्रैर्बहुभिः परिवारिता। एवं समुदिता नारी का त्वन्या दुःखिता भवेत्॥
en: Being surrounded by numerous brothers, father-in-law and sons and thus having ample cause for rejoicing what other woman but myself has become so miserable?

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा संगृह्य धनुषी शुभे। कोऽयं पितरमस्माकं नाम्नाऽऽहेत्यूचतुश्च तौ॥
en: Thus addressed by him, they put their auspicious bows aside and said "who is this one that is mentioning the name of our father?”

sa: अर्जुन उवाच भ्रातुर्नियोगाज्ज्येष्ठस्य संवत्सरमिदं व्रतम्। चरामि व्रतचर्यं च सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Arjuna said To tell you the truth I am observing this vow for one year in satisfaction of the command of my elder brother,

sa: दीर्णं हि दृष्ट्वा राजानं सर्वमेवानुदीर्यते। राष्ट्र बलममात्याश्च पृथक् कुर्वन्ति ते मती:॥
en: Seeing a king struck with fear, all are struck with fear-the entire kingdom, the army, the ministers and the earth are divided into factions.

sa: शल्यस्य प्रेष्यतां शीघ्रं ये च तस्यानुगा नृपाः। भगदत्ताय राज्ञे च पूर्वसागरवासिने॥
en: Send quickly to Shalya and to those kings who are under his suzerainty and the king Bhagadatta and the inhabitants of the Eastern seas,

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच ततो विवदमानः स मुनिभिः सह वासव। अथ मामस्पृशन्मूर्ध्नि पादेनाधर्मपीडितः॥
en: Agastya said Then, O Vasava, he began quarreling with the Rishis and then the one, ruled by vice, touched my head with his feet.

sa: अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलं लाभस्य च शुभस्य च। महान् भवत्यनिर्विण्णः सुखं चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: These bring on prosperity; so do constant meetings with the good. Perseverance is the root the of prosperity and of gain and of happiness.

sa: त्वद् द्वेषाच्च महाबाहो ममापि द्वेष्टुमर्हति। विगर्हते च मां नित्यं त्वत्समीपे नरेश्वर॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, from the illness he bears towards you, he insults me; O lord of men, in your presence he always abuses me.

sa: मातङ्गो मत्त इव च परीयात् समहामनाः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमेन्नित्यं धर्मायैव च संजय॥
en: That great-minded man the Kshatriya should move about like an infuriated elephant and he should ever bow down to Brahmanas for virtue. O Sanjaya.

sa: सुमहच्चापि तत् कर्म यन्नरेण कृतं पुरा। ततो गुणैः सुबहुभिः श्रेष्ठो नारायणोऽभवत्॥
en: The deed, which was achieved by Nara in days of old, was very great indeed. Narayana was still greater in regard to many virtues.

sa: सुदेष्णोवाच उत्तिष्ठ गच्छ सैरन्ध्र कीचकस्य निवेशनम्। पानमानय कल्याणि पिपासा मां प्रबाधते॥
en: Sudeshna said O Sairandhri, get up and repair to the abode of Kichaka. O gentle one, bring wine for ime, for thirst afflicts me.

sa: तया दत्तानि भोज्यानि पानानि विविधानि च। भुक्त्वा लब्धबलाः सन्तस्तयोक्तेन पथा ततः॥
en: She gave us many sorts of eatables and drinkable. Regaining our strength after partaking of food, we proceeded along the route indicated by her.

sa: आवन्त्यांश्च वशे कृत्वा साम्ना च भरतर्षभ। वृष्णिभिः सह संगम्य पश्चिमामपि निर्जयत्॥
en: O foremost of Bharata race, having subjugated the Avantis and concluded peace with them and having fought with the Vrishnis, he conquered the west.

sa: ततो रथेन शुभ्रेण महता किङ्किणीकिना। कुरूणां पश्यतां दुष्टुं स्वसारं स पितुर्ययौ॥
en: Then in that white chariot and large, furnished with thinking bells he went to the sister of his father, the Kurus looking at him.

sa: निरर्थं कलहं प्राज्ञो वर्जयेन्मूढसेवितम्। कीर्ति च लभते लोके न चानर्थेन युज्यते॥
en: A wise man should avoid unprofitable quarrels, to which fools alone are parties. By this one gains fame in this world and avoids misery.

sa: निर्मोचने षट् सहस्रा: पाशैर्बद्धा महासुराः। चहीतुं नाशकंश्चैनं तं त्वं प्रार्थयसे बलात्॥
en: In the city if Nirmochana sixty thousand great Asuras could not capture him with their nooses and you want to capture him by force.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं क्षत्ता पुन: प्रावेशयत् सभाम्। अकामं भ्रातृभिः सार्धं राजभिः परिवारितम्॥
en: Then did Kshattri again cause Duryodhana to enter the council chamber, unwilling as he was along with his brothers, and surrounded by the kings.

sa: संनिधौ ते महाराज क्रोधजं पापबुद्धिजम्। एष दुर्योधनो राजन् यथेच्छति तथाऽस्तु तत्॥
en: What this Duryodhana, O king, wishes to do in your presence, in consequence of wrath and sinful heart, O great king, let him do.

sa: आसाद्य न भविष्यन्ति पतङ्गा इव पावकम्। अयमिच्छन् हि तान् सर्वान् युध्यमानाञ्जनार्दनः॥
en: Having stood against they will cease to exist as worms in contact with fire. This Janardana, desiring the good of all when lighting, never

sa: वने द्वादश वर्षाणि यानि सोढानि दुर्मते। तस्याद्य प्रतिकोपस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि सम्प्रति॥
en: O wicked one, we have undergone many miseries in the forest for twelve years. Do you now reap the fruit of our vengeance today

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवाः सर्वे वासुदेवस्य भाषितम्। अब्रुवन्तो मुखं राज्ञःसमुदैक्षन्त भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing those words spoken by Vasudeva all the kings looked on the face of the king Yudhishthira, without saying anything, O Bharata.

sa: षड् दोषाः पुरुषेणेह हातव्या भूतिमिच्छता। निद्रा तन्द्रा भयं क्रोध आलस्यं दीर्घसूत्रता॥
en: These six defects should be shunned by a man in this world who desires for prosperity viz., sleep drowsiness, fear, anger, laziness and procrastination.

sa: तं ममाचक्ष्व वार्ष्णेय कथमद्य वृकोदरः। आस्ते परिघबाहुः स मध्यमः पाण्डवो बली॥
en: Tell me, O scion of the Vrishni race, how Vrikodara is doing now, the one having macelike arms, that mighty second son of Pandu.

sa: अनेन मृष्टनयनो भूतान्यन्तर्हितान्युत। भवान् द्रक्ष्यति यस्मै च प्रदास्यति नरः स तु॥
en: If you wash your eyes with this you and any man whom you may give this will be able to see all invisible creatures."

sa: अनुकूलो भवेच्चास्य सर्वार्थेषु कथासु च। अप्रियं चाहितं यत् स्यात् तदस्मै नानुवर्णयेत्॥
en: In all matters and works one ought to be well-disposed towards the king and should never relate to him what is disagreeable and unprofitable.

sa: न चानुशिष्याद् राजानमपृच्छन्तं कदाचन। तूष्णीं त्वेनमुपासीत काले समभिपूजयेत्॥ असूयन्ति हि राजानो जनाननृतवादिनः। तथैव चावमन्यन्ते मन्त्रिणं वादिनं मृषा॥
en: Unasked no one should even offer a counsel to the king; one should pay respect to never him with reticence and homage in time. Kings wish to have those who babble and hate counsellors who tell lies.

sa: अन्तश्चरति भूतानां मातरिश्वा सदागतिः। स मे विमुञ्चतु प्राणान् यदि पापं चराम्यहम्॥
en: The air which is always in motion, moves within (the hearts of) all the creatures. If I have sinned, let it forsake my life.

sa: सभास्तारो भविष्यामि तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः। कङ्को नाम द्विजो भूत्वा मताक्षः प्रियदेवनः॥
en: Appearing as a twice-born one, Kanka by name, expert in dice and fond of game, I shall be a counter of that high-minded king.

sa: यो हि धर्मं समाश्रित्य भर्तुः प्रियाप्रिये। अप्रियाण्याहं पथ्यानि तेन राजा सहायवान्।॥
en: He, who having an eye on virtue and disregarding what is a agreeable or disagreeable but beneficial, is a real help to his king.

sa: जागर्मि रात्रयः सर्वा दीर्घमुष्णं च निःश्वसन्। भीतो वृकोदरात् तात सिंहात् पशुरिवापरः॥
en: I am awake during entire nights breathing large and hot sighs, being afraid of Vrikodara, O dear, as any other animal fears a lion.

sa: क्रोधाग्निमुत्सृजन् वीरो धार्तराष्ट्रेषु पाण्डवः॥ तस्य तद् दहतः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा चैव पराक्रमम्।
en: The dreadful son of Pandu discharging his fire of anger at the sons of Dhritarashtra and beholding his dreadful prowess burning down the army.

sa: तथा धौम्येन धर्मज्ञो वाक्यैः सम्परितोषितः। शास्त्रबुद्ध्या स्वबुद्ध्या च न चचाल युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Thus cheered by these words of Dhaumya, the virtuous Yudhishthira, relying on his own wisdom and also that gained from Shastras, regained his patience.

sa: तमथाश्वासयन् सर्वे ब्राह्मणा भ्रातृभिः सह। अथ धौम्योऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं महार्थं नृपतिं तदा॥
en: After that the Brahmanas and his brothers began to cheer him up. Then Dhaumya told the King these worlds of fraught and great meaning.

sa: दुर्विनीता: श्रियं प्राप्य विद्यामैश्वर्यमेव च। तिष्ठन्ति न चिरं भद्रे यथाहं मदगर्वितः॥
en: Like me who was puffed up with vanity, insolent men, even obtaining prosperity, knowledge and affluence, are never blessed for any length of time.

sa: धुमत्सेन उवाच पूर्वमेवाभिलषितः सम्बन्धो मे त्वया सह। भ्रष्टराज्यस्त्वहमिति तत एतद् विचारितम्॥
en: Dyumatsena said: Formerly, I cherished a desire of forming an alliance with you. (But) deprived of my kingdom (afterwards) I hesitated (to do it).

sa: एवं यः सर्वभूतेषु आत्मानमनुपश्यति। अन्यत्रान्यत्र युक्तेषु किं स शोचेत् ततः परम्॥
en: The man who thus perceives soul in all creatures, why should he grieve after this perception? Grief comes to those who are employed occupations.

sa: पाण्डवेन हताः शूरा भीष्मस्य स्थरक्षिणः। शेरते स्म तदा राजन कौन्तेयस्याभितो स्थम्॥
en: O king! the chivalrous soldiers protecting the chariot of Bhishma were fell down dead both side of that chariot as Arjuna had killed them.

sa: राजन् नान्यत् प्रवक्तव्यं तव नैःश्रेयसं वचः। विदितं ह्येव ते सर्वं वेदितव्यमरिंदम्॥
en: Oking, I have nothing else to say, everything that ought to be known in this world is known to you, O chastiser of foes.

sa: अवतीर्य रथात् कन्या नमस्कृत्य च बन्धुषु। उपगम्य वनं पुण्यं तपस्तेपे ययातिजा॥
en: Getting down from the chariot, the damsel saluted her friends and having gone to the sacred forest, the lady born of Yayati, practiced austerities,

sa: स त्वं पुत्रैश्च पौत्रेश्च पितृभिर्धातृभिस्तथा। सुहृद्धिः सर्वतो गुप्तः सुखं शक्ष्यसि जीवितुम्॥
en: You will be able to live in happiness being protected on all sides by your sons and grandsons, your fathers and brothers and friends.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच वासुदेवस्य तद् वाक्यमनुस्मृत्य युधिष्ठिरः। पुनः पप्रच्छ वार्ष्णेयं कथं मन्दोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Yudhishthira, remembering these words of Vasudeva again asked the scion of the Vrishni race as to how that fool could say it.

sa: सोऽयं मृत्युवंश यातः कथं जिष्णुमहाबलः। अयं ममाशां संहत्य शेते भूमौ धनंजयः॥ आश्रित्य यं वयं नाथं दुःखान्येतानि सेहिम।
en: How is it, then, that this highly powerful Jishnu has been subject to death? Why does that Dhananjaya lie dead on the ground destroying all my hopes, depending on whom we have gone through all these miseries?

sa: गालव उवाच एकतः श्यामकर्णानां शतान्यष्टौ प्रयच्छ मे। हयानां चन्द्रशुभ्राणां देशजानां वपुष्मताम्॥
en: Galava said Give me eight hundred horses, white as the moon, born in this country, and with plump bodies, cach having one ear black.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु कर्णेन धार्तराष्ट्रो विशाम्पते। पुरोहितं समानाय्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥ राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठं समाप्तवरदक्षिणम्। आहर त्वं मम कृते यथान्यायं यथाक्रमम्॥
en: O king, having been thus addressed by Karna, Dhritarashtra's son summoned the priest and spoke to him him these words, “Celebrate duly and in proper order the foremost of all sacrifices the Rajasuya abounding in large Dakshinas."

sa: अद्य मे विगतः शोकः प्रीतिरद्य परा मम। सुहृदं त्वां समासाद्य महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम्॥
en: Obtaining you as my friend like to Mahendra and Varuņa, my grief has been removed and I have attained to an excess of delight.

sa: नेदानी गुह योग्योऽयं वासो मे सजने वने। अवश्यमाश्रमे वासः कर्तव्यस्तद्गतो विधिः॥
en: O Guha, I should not now reside in a forest inhabited by men. I should certainly now abide in an asylum in proper guise.

sa: यो हि मां सेवते कश्चिदपि वाप्यनुवर्तते। कैकेय्या पुत्रमन्वीक्ष्य स जनो नाभिभाषते॥
en: Those who serve me or are obedient to me, shall not even speak with me when they will see the son of Kaikeyi (installed).

sa: ते तु दृष्टिगतं दृष्ट्वा तं शैलं बहुकन्दरम्। अध्यारोहन्त हरयो वीक्षमाणाः समन्ततः॥
en: And having surveyed that hill having many a grot, so far as the eye could range, the monkeys looking all round, descended (the eminence).

sa: तेन मायाविना दूरमपवाह्य नृपात्मजौ ॥ जहार भार्या रामस्य गृधं हत्वा जटायुषम्।
en: That one (Mārīca) commanding illusions, having drawn far the king's sons (Rāma and Lakşmaņa), he (Rāvana) carried away Rāma's wife, slaying the vulture Jatayu.

sa: बन्धयिष्यति वा पाशैरथ वास्मान् वधिष्यति। अनु दाशरथिं रामं पित्रा राज्याद् विवासितम्॥
en: Be like, he will either bind us by nooses or slay us and next Daśaratha's son Rāma banished from the kingdom by his sire.

sa: आश्रमं चिरसंवृद्धं यद् विनाशितवानसि। दुराचारो हि यन्मूढस्तस्मात् त्वं न भविष्यसि ॥
en: Since, O fool, you have destroyed this hermitage that had been prospering for a long time, you of execrable ways shall not live long.

sa: स महीं मनुना राज्ञा दत्तामिक्ष्वाकवे पुरा । स्फीतां राष्ट्रवृतां रामो वैदेहीमन्वदर्शयत्॥
en: Here Rāma showed to Vaidehi those flourishing regions that had formerly been conferred by king Manu on Ikşvāku, and which teemed with populous tracts.

sa: वनानि सरितः शैलान् सरांसि च विहायसा॥ स क्षिप्रं समतीयाय शरश्चापादिव च्युतः।
en: And speedily, like an arrow shot from a bow, he, coursing the welkin, left behind woods and streams and mountains and pieces of water.

sa: रामः सत्पुरुषो लोके सत्यः सत्यपरायणः। साक्षाद् रामाद् विनिर्वृनो धर्मश्चापि श्रिया सह॥
en: Rāma is the one excellent person among men; and is true and devoted to truth. And in very Rāma is established morality with prosperity.

sa: स तु श्रेष्ठैर्गुणैर्युक्तः प्रजानां पार्थिवात्मजः। बहिश्चर इव प्राणो बभूव गुणतः प्रियः॥
en: Endowed with supreme excellence that son or the monarch was by virtue of his merit dear to the subjects like their life ranging externally.

sa: तेषां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा स्कन्नं गर्भपरिस्रवे। स्नापयन् परया लक्ष्म्या दीप्यमानं यथानलम्॥
en: And hearing those words of theirs, the Kșttikās bathed the offspring that had issued from her womb, flaming like fire, and with auspicious marks.

sa: प्रियं कृतं हि रामस्य धर्मज्ञेन जटायुषा। राघवार्थे परिश्रान्ता तयं संत्यक्तजीविताः॥ कान्ताराणि प्रपन्नाः स्म न च पश्याम मैथिलीम्।
en: Therefore the righteous Jațãyu, of his own accord laying down his life, has done the pleasure of Rāma. We also, overcome with fatigue and (almost) dying, have come to this forest; but Mithila's daughter we find not.

sa: तस्य पादौ च संगृह्य रामः सीता च लक्ष्मणः। निषेदुस्तदनुज्ञाता लब्धवासा निमन्त्रिताः॥
en: Taking his feet, Rāma, Sītā and Lakşmaņa sat down with the permission of the ascetic, who received them and set apart quarters for them.

sa: अम्ब मा दुःखिता भूत्वा पश्येस्त्वं पितरं मम। क्षयोऽपि वनवासस्य क्षिप्रमेव भविष्यति॥
en: O mother, without indulging in grief, you should minister to my father, and the term of my abode in the woods will shortly expire.

sa: समुन्मूलय शोकं त्वं व्यवसायं स्थिरीकुरु। ततः सपरिवारं तं राक्षसं हन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Do you renounce your grief and take recourse to energy and you shall be able to slay that Rākş asa with all his family.

sa: न चात्र वृक्षा नौषध्यो न वल्ल्यो नापि वीरुधः। स्निग्धपत्राः स्थले यत्र पद्मिन्यः फुल्लपङ्कजाः॥ प्रेक्षणीयाः सुगन्धाश्च भ्रमरैश्च विवर्जिताः।
en: And there are there neither trees, nor annual plants, nor creepers, nor herbs,-and in that place there are no pleasant pools, with cool leaves, and filled with blown lotuses, and it has been renounced by the black-bees.

sa: अनुक्रोशो दया चैव यथार्ह मयि वः कृतः। चिरं दुःखस्य पापीयो गम्यतामर्थसिद्धये॥
en: You have shown due compassion and regret for me. To grieve long is not fit. do you therefore repair to look after your interests.

sa: तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। विलपन्तो नरा घोरं व्यतिष्ठंश्च क्वचित् क्वचित्॥
en: Thereupon saluting that high-souled one and going round him, bewailing all the while in heaviness of heart, they at times stopped on their way.

sa: रामप्रव्रजनं दूरं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च। भरतः क्रियतां राजा पृथिव्यां पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: Send Rāma to the forest for nine and five years, and let Bharata, becoming on earth the foremost of monarchs, carry on the Government.

sa: भजस्व सीते मामेव भर्ताहं सदृशस्तव। यौवनं त्वध्रुवं भीरु रमस्वेह मया सह॥
en: O Sītā, bend your mind to me. I am a fit husband for you. O timed one, youth is uncertain. Sport with me here.

sa: यो हि मामुद्यतस्त्रातुं सोऽप्ययं विनिपातितः। गृध्रराजः पुराणोऽसौ श्वशुरस्य सखा मम ॥
en: And he also that endeavoured to rescue me, has been slain by you—the ancient king of vultures, who was the friend of my father-in-law.

sa: नाद्यापि श्रूयते शब्दो मत्तानां मृगपक्षिणाम्। सरक्तां मधुरां वाणी कलं व्याहरतां बहु॥
en: Still do I not hear the inarticulate though sweet and delicious voice of beasts and birds crying in chorus.* *Some text read muhus, momentarily.

sa: स रामः स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पृथिवीपतिम्। उवाच भरतं वाक्यं धर्मात्मा धर्मसंहितम्॥
en: And hearing that lord of earth, his sire, had gone to heaven, that righteous one said to Bharata words fraught with virtue and interest.

sa: सा विनीय तमायासमुपस्पृश्य जलं शुचि। चकार माता रामस्य मङ्गलानि मनस्विनी॥ न शक्यसे वारयितं गच्छेदानी रघूत्तम। शीघ्रं च विनिवर्तस्व वर्तस्व च सतां क्रमे॥
en: Kausalyā subduing her sorrow, and touching holy water, began to perform auspicious ceremonies for Rāma, and spoke to him saying Do you, Oh best amongst the descendants of Raghu, repair now, as I cannot dissuade you, but do you return speedily and, follow the footsteps of great ones.

sa: ते प्रविष्टास्तु वेगेन तद् बिलं कपिकुञ्जराः॥ प्रकाशं चाभिरामं च ददृशुर्देशमुत्तमम्। ततस्तस्मिन् बिले भीमे नानापादपसंकुले॥ अन्योन्यं सम्परिष्वज्य जग्मुर्योजनमन्तरम्।
en: And those foremost of monkeys rushed into the cavity; and beheld displayed (before them) an excellent and charming scene. And embracing each other in that fearful cave rife with various trees, they passed over an hundred Yojanas.

sa: संस्कृत्य वालिनं तु विधिवत् प्लवगर्षभाः। आजग्मुरुदकं कर्तुं नदी शुभजलां शिवाम् ॥
en: Having duly cremated Vāli's body, the foremost of monkeys arrived at a river of auspicious water with a view to perform the watery ceremony.

sa: कौसल्यापि तदा देवी रात्रि स्थित्वा समाहिता। प्रभाते चाकरोत् पूजां विष्णोः पुत्रहितैषिणी॥
en: Worshipful Kausalyā, seeking her son's welfare, kept up the whole night being absorbed in meditation, and was, in the morning, worshipping the God Vişņu.

sa: बालो ह्यकृतविद्यश्च न च वेत्ति बलाबलम्। न चास्त्रबलसंयुक्तो न च युद्धविशारदः॥
en: Youthful, and unaccomplished, and not knowing what constitutes strength and what not, and not equipped with the science of missiles, and unskilful in fight.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे बीजमुष्टिः प्रकीर्यते। अराजके पितुः पुत्रो भार्या वा वर्तते वशे॥
en: In a kingless kingdom no one sows corn. In a kingless kingdom the son does not obey his sire, or the wife her husband.

sa: न संतप्येद् यथा चासौ वनवासं गते मयि। महाराजस्तथा कार्यो मम प्रियचिकीर्षया॥
en: And seeking my good, it beloves you to act so that when I shall have gone to the forest, the king may not grieve.

sa: किं ते सर्वविनाशेन कृतेन पुरुषर्षभ। तमेव तु रिपुं पापं विज्ञायोद्धर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O you best of men, what necessity have you to destroy the whole world? Do you rescue Sītā after finding out your vicious enemy.

sa: दत्ताभयवधो नाम पातकं महदद्भुतम्। अहं च लक्ष्मणश्चैव सीता च वरवर्णिना॥ त्वदधीना वयं सर्वे वनेऽस्मिशरणं भवान्। तस्माद् युध्यस्व भूयस्त्वं मा माशङ्कीश्च वानर ॥
en: Mighty is the sin that ariseth from the destruction of one who has been offered shelter. Myself, Laksmana, and that exquisitely fine damsel-Sita-are all at your service-you or are our only refuge in this forest. Do you again enter into conflict, therefore, and do not fear, O monkey.

sa: दानसंवनना ह्येते ग्रन्था मेधाविभिः कृताः। यजस्व देहि दीक्षस्व तपस्तप्यस्व संत्यज ॥
en: Works (on morality) enjoining, Worship,' 'Give away,' 'Be initiated,' 'Observe rites,' "Renounce', have been composed by intelligent persons, for inducing people to be charitable.

sa: अथ तस्य च शब्देन गीतेनाप्रतिमेन च। दर्शनेन च रम्भाया मुनिः संदेहमागतः॥
en: Anon, listening to the warbling of the Cole and her own incomparable singing, as well as beholding Rambha, the ascetic began to entertain doubts.

sa: अयमिक्ष्वाकुदायादो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः। तस्यैवावरजं विद्धि भ्रातरं मां च लक्ष्मणम्॥
en: He is a descendant of the Ikşvākus known on earth by the name of Rāma, and know me as his younger brother, by name-Laksmana.

sa: दृश्यमानस्तु युध्येथा मया युधि नृपात्मज। अद्य वैवस्वतं देवं पश्येस्त्वं निहतो मया॥
en: O son of a king, hadst you fought with me openly you wouldst have, forsooth, seen the abode of Death being killed by me.

sa: प्लवमानश्च मे दृष्टः स तस्मिन् गोमये हृदे। पिबन्नञ्जलिना तैलं हसन्निव मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: And I saw him floating on a sink of cowdung, and yet with a momentary laugh drinking oil by means of his joined hands.

sa: सुदृष्टां कुरु किष्किन्धां कुरुष्वात्मसमं पुरे। क्रीडस्व च समं स्त्रीभिरहं ते दर्पशासनः॥
en: Do you survey Kişkindhã and make your children kings. And do you enjoy with your wives-it is me that shall crush down your pride.

sa: अन्तःपुरं प्रवेश्यास्मै कन्यां दत्त्वा यथाविधि। शान्तां शान्तेन मनसा राजा हर्षमवाप सः॥
en: And taking him into the inner apartments, and in due form conferring upon him in sober mood his daughter śāntā, the king became happy.

sa: को हि रूपमिदं श्रेष्ठं संत्यज्य वरवर्णिनि। मानुषीषु वरारोहे कुर्याद् भावं विचक्षणः॥
en: O paragon among damsels, O supremely charming lady, what man possessed of discernment, passing by such grace, would bear affliction to a human female?

sa: स च राजा नरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञस्य च समाप्तवान्। फलं बहुगुणं राम सहस्राक्षप्रसादजम्॥
en: And, O foremost of men, that king also, having completed the sacrifice, obtained the manifold fruit thereof through the grace of the thousand-eyed deity,

sa: शैलेन्द्रो हिमवान् राम धातूनामाकरो महान्। तस्य कन्याद्वयं राम रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि ॥
en: O Rāma, that great mine of ore, Himavat is the foremost of mountains. To him were born two daughters, unparalleled on earth in loveliness.

sa: स राज्ञो दर्शनाकानी द्वाराध्यक्षानुवाच ह॥ शीघ्रमाख्यात मां प्राप्तं कौशिकं गाधिनः सुतम्।
en: Desirous of seeing the king, he said to the warders,-Do you speedily announce that I, Gadhi's son, sprung in the Kusika line, have come!

sa: संश्रुत्य शैब्यः श्येनाय स्वां तनुं जगतीपतिः। प्रदाय पक्षिणे राजा जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Having promised his own person to the hawk, that lord of earth, Saivya, having granted the same to the bird, went the excellent way.

sa: समीपजान् दुमान् भञ्जन् वसुधां दारयन् खुरैः। विषाणेनोल्लिखन् दर्पात् तद्द्वारं द्विरदो यथा॥
en: Like to an elephant he felled, out of haughtiness, the trees around, and rent the earth with his hoofs scraping it with his horns.

sa: त्रस्तरूपं तु विज्ञाय जगत् सर्वं महानृषिः। नृपतिं सुव्रतो धीरो वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: And knowing that the entire universe was in trepidation, that mighty saint, the sedate Vasiştha of excellent vows, said these words to the king.

sa: विचित्य तु वनं सर्वं समुद्र दक्षिणां दिशम्। वयं बुभुक्षिताः सर्वे वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रिताः॥
en: Having searched through the forest as well as the ocean on the South, we becoming hungry, sat down at the foot of a tree.

sa: गज सा गजनासोरूय॑दि दृष्ट्वा त्वया भवेत् तां मन्ये विदितां तुभ्यमाख्याहि वरवारण॥
en: O elephant, methinks you do know about the daughter of Janaka having thighs resembling your trunk; pray tell me if you have beheld her.

sa: या हि नः सततं बुद्धिर्वेदमन्त्रानुसारिणी। त्वत्कृते सा कृता वत्स वनवासानुसारिणी॥ मतिः।
en: That intelligence of ours which ever follows the Vedic Mantras, is now, O child, ready to follow you to the forest in your interests.

sa: न मन्ये ब्रह्मचर्ये वा स्वधीते वा फलोदयः। मार्दवार्जवयोर्वापि त्वां चेद् व्यसनमागतम्॥
en: I deem the Brahmacarya mode of life, or study, or meekness or sincerity as attended with no fruit, since you have come by calamity.

sa: या पुरा कलहंसानां कलेन कलभाषिणी। बुध्यते चारुसर्वाङ्गी साद्य मे रमते कथम्॥
en: How that exquisitely fine damsel having a sweet voice shall be pleased to-day, who used formerly to awake at the sounds of the drakes.?

sa: शोचामि दुर्मतित्वं ते का हि प्राज्ञा प्रहर्षयेत्। अरेः सपत्नीपुत्रस्य वृद्धिं मृत्योरिवागताम्॥
en: I lament you for your perversion of sense. What sensible woman can rejoice in the advancement of a co-wife's son, like to death itself?

sa: तव हि मुखमिदं निरीक्ष्य कोपात् क्षतजसमे नयने निरीक्षमाणाः। हरिवरवनिता न यान्ति शान्ति प्रथमभयस्य हि शङ्किताः स्म सर्वाः॥
en: Seeing this your face wrought up with wrath, and your eyes appearing like red sores, the wives of the best of monkeys experience no peace, and they are agitated by the fear that exercised them of late.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः। हृष्टरोमा महातेजाः शतानन्दो महातपाः॥ गौतमस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभः। रामसंदर्शनादेव परं विस्मयमागतः॥
en: Hearing the narration of the intelligent Viśvāmitra, Gautama's eldest son, the exceedingly energetic Śatänanda of rigid austerities, highly effulgent by virtue of his asceticism, with his down standing on end wondered greatly at the sight of Rāma.

sa: कस्यायमाश्रमः पुण्यः को न्वस्मिन् वसते पुमान्। भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छावः परं कौतूहलं हि लो॥
en: Whose is this sacred hemmilage? And what man lives here? O worshipfui one, we are desirous of hcasing this. Surciy, great is our curiosity.

sa: कृत्वा कण्ठे स्म सा चीरमेकमादाय पाणिना। तस्थौ ह्यकुशला तत्र व्रीडिता जनकात्मजा॥
en: Putting on one piece on her neck and holding the other in her hand, the daughter of Janaka, feeling uneasy, stood overpowered with shame.

sa: सिद्धार्था खलु वैदेही पति यानुगता वनम्। वयं संशयिताः सर्वे हीनास्तेन महात्मना॥
en: And blessed is Videha's daughter who follows her husband into the woods. Bereft of that magnanimous one, we have all been brought into jeopardy.

sa: न तु पश्यामि तच्छत्रं पाण्डुरं लोकविश्रुतम्। पितुर्दिव्यं महाभाग संशयो भवतीह मे॥
en: But, you exalted one, I do not see the splendid white umbrella of our father known among men. Therefore, doubts arise in my mind.

sa: विधवा पृथिवी राजंस्त्वया हीना न राजते। हीनचन्द्रव रजनी नगरी प्रतिभाति माम्॥
en: Widowed in consequence of losing you, this earth does not look graceful. The city appears to me like the night deprived of the Moon

sa: अगस्त्येन तदा देवैः प्रार्थितेन महर्षिणा। अनुभूय किल श्राद्धे भक्षितः स महासुरः॥
en: (And it came to pass that once upon a time) the Maharși Agastya, having been invited to a Sraddha, fed on the mighty Asura.

sa: अयं स पुरुषव्याघ्रो द्वारि तिष्ठति ते सुतः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा सर्वं चैवोपजीविनाम्॥ स त्वां पश्यतु भद्रं ते रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। सर्वान् सुहृद आपृच्छ्य त्वां हीदानी दिदृक्षते॥ गमिष्यति महारण्यं तं पश्य जगतीपते। वृतं राजगुणैः सर्वैरादित्यमिव रश्मिभिः॥
en: O foremost of men, your son waits at the entrance, after having distributed wealth to Brāhmaṇas and his retinue. Let that one having truth for prowess, good betide you, see you. Having greeted all his friends, he now wishes to see you. Know that he is about to set out for the mighty forest. Do you, O Lord of earth, see him furnished with every perfection, like the Sun himself surrounded by his rays.:

sa: आयता दश च द्वे च योजनानि महापुरी। श्रीमती त्रीणि विस्तीर्णा सुविभक्तमहापथा॥
en: That beautiful and mighty city was twelve Yojanas in length and Three in breadth; and was intersected outside with spacious roads laid out orderly.

sa: को नु दारप्रणाशं ते साधु मन्येत राघव। सरितः सागराः शैला देवगन्धर्वदानवाः॥ नालं ते विप्रियं कर्तुं दीक्षितस्येव साधवः।
en: Who shall think well, O Raghava, of the destruction of your wife? The celestials, Danavas, Gandharvas, rivers, seas, and mountains-none can act unfriendly by you as the learned priests cannot act improperly towards those initiated by them.

sa: विज्ञानं हि महद् भ्रष्टं शापदोषेण राघव। स्वकृतेन मया प्राप्तं रूपं लोकविगर्हितम्॥
en: By the influence of curse, I have lost my foresight and by my own improper actions I have been transformed into this ugly figure.

sa: इत्युक्तः परुषं वाक्यं सीतया रोमहर्षणम्॥ अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः सीतां प्राञ्जलिः स जितेन्द्रियः। उत्तरं सोत्सहे वक्तुं दैवतं भवता मम ॥
en: Hearing these brazen words of Sītā, capable of making one's down stand on end, the selfcontrolled Lakşmaņa with joined hands spake to her saying You are a very Goddess to me, I therefore dare not answer you.

sa: वैदेही चापि तत् सर्वं न शुश्राव तपस्विनी। तदेव हृदि तस्याश्च यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्॥
en: Vaidehi, ever engaged in ascetic rites, did not hear of all these affairs; there was in her heart only the thought of Rāma's installation.

sa: ततस्तथेत्युवाचैनं रावणं ताटकासुतः। ततो रावणमारीचौ विमानमिव तं रथम्॥ आरुह्याययतुः शीघ्रं तस्मादाश्रममण्डलात्।
en: Thereupon Tārakā's son assented to Rāvana's words, and both of them ascending the chariot like to a heavenly car set out for the hermitage.

sa: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन। एतत्ते प्रतिजानामि सत्येनैव शपाम्यहम्॥
en: Falsehoods have I never spoken before, nor will I ever say one (in future). This I promise to you. I swear by truth itself.

sa: प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये कारयित्वा जटा उभौ। अस्मिन् भागीरथीतीरे सुखं संतारितौ मया॥
en: In the morning, with an unclouded sun, both, having made matted locks on the banks of the Bhāgīrathi, crossed the river along with me.

sa: हृदयं सुस्थितं मह्यं दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि। यन्न शोकाभिसंतप्तं स्फुटतेऽद्य सहस्रधा ॥
en: Forsooth, my heart is uncommon hard, since beholding you on the ground it has not been sundered into thousand pieces being overwhelmed with grief.

sa: अप्रमत्तश्च यो राजा सर्वज्ञो विजितेन्द्रियः। कृतज्ञो धर्मशीलश्च स राजा तिष्ठते चिरम्॥
en: But a king that keeps his wits about him, understands everything, is of controlled senses, and grateful, and of virtuous character, endure for ever.

sa: आरुह्यतामयं शीघ्रं खगो रत्नविभूषितः। मया सह रथो युक्त : पिशाचवदनैः खरैः॥
en: Do you now with me ascend this chariot coursing in the air, crested with jewels and driven by asses having faces of a demon.

sa: सद्यः सौम्यं परित्यज्य तीक्ष्णरूपं स रावणः। स्वं रूपं कालरूपाभं भेजे वैश्रवणानुजः॥
en: Thereat Răvana, the younger brother of the Lord of wealth, changing his placid countenance, instantly assumed his own terrible shape resembling that of Yama.

sa: इति रामो मुनेः श्रुत्वा सह भ्रात्राऽभिवाद्य च। प्रतस्थेऽगस्त्यमुद्दिश्य सानुगः सह सीतया॥
en: Hearing these words of the anchorite, Rāma, saluting him, along with his brother, set off for Agastya's (place) with his younger brother and Sītā.

sa: ततस्त्वां निहतं दृष्ट्वा वायुर्गन्धवहः स्वयम्। त्रैलोक्यं भृशसंक्रुद्धो न ववौ वै प्रभञ्जनः॥
en: Witnessing you beaten back, that bearer of fumes himself, the Wind, that breaketh everything before in wrath did not blow through the three worlds.

sa: अवश्यं कुर्वतां तस्य दृश्यते कर्मणः फलम्। परं निर्वेदमागम्य नहि नोन्मीलनं क्षमम्॥
en: Those who act, for certain behold the fruit of their endeavours; but if people once give way to grief, they cannot again attain vigour.

sa: नर्दमानांश्च नादेन पातयेयुर्विहङ्गमान्। ईदृशानां प्रसूतानि हरीणां कामरूपिणाम्॥ शतं शतसहस्राणि यूथपानां महात्मनाम्।
en: And with their roars, they could bring down birds singing. Thus came into being Koțis of high-souled leaders of monkey-herds, assuming forms at will.

sa: कैकेय्या वञ्चितो राजा मयि चारण्यमाश्रिते। भवत्या च परित्यक्तो न नूनं वर्तयिष्यति॥
en: "The monarch has been duped by Kaikeyi” myself resorting to the forest, surely shall he resign his life, if cast off again by you.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच मधुसूदन मा कार्षीर्विषादं यदुनन्दन॥ अद्य पारं गमिष्यामि वैरस्य भृशदुर्गमम्।
en: Bhimasena said O killer of Madhu, do not, O delighted of the Yadus, grieve. However difficult it may be, I shall terminate these hostilities.

sa: कांश्चिद् योधान् स खड्ड्रेन मध्ये संछिद्य वीर्यवान्।। ११२ अपातयद् द्रोणपुत्रः संरब्धस्तिलकाण्डवत्।
en: Filled with rage the brave son of Drona, struck down some of the warriors, cutting them in two with his sword like sesame stalks.

sa: धिगस्त्वर्थं यत्कृतेऽयं महान् ज्ञातिवधः कृतः। वय॑ते सुहृदां चैवं युद्धेऽस्मिन् वै पराभवः॥
en: "Fie on this interest" which is the cause of a great massacre of kinsmen-in this was those that are friends will meet with defeat.

sa: जयद्रथस्य कर्णस्य तथा दुःशासनस्य च। सौबलस्य च दुर्बुद्ध्या मिथो भेदोः प्रपत्स्यते॥
en: The dispute in this instance has its rise in the wicked intelligence of Jayadratha, Karna, and Dushasana, as also of the son of Subala.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव च ध्यात्वा व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः। नृपं शयानं गाड्यमिदमाह वचस्तदा॥ राजन् प्रकृतिमापन्नः कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। सहितो भ्रातृभिः सर्वैः पार्थिवैश्चानुयायिभिः॥
en: Then Vyasa the son of Satyavati, having thought for a moment, addressed the royal son of Ganga, saying, O king, the Kuru king Yudhishthira has been restored to his own nature, with all his brothers and followers.

sa: ततः सुखोपविष्टस्तं व्याधं वचनमब्रवीत्। कर्मैतद् वै न सदृशं भवतः प्रतिभाति मे। अनुतप्ये भृशं तात तव घोरेण कर्मणा॥
en: Seated himself at his ease. Thereupon he addressed the fowler, saying, "It appears to me that this business is not really suitable to you. O father, I greatly regret that you should adopt such a dishonourable profession",

sa: न चारिजं भयं तस्य नापुत्रो वा भवेन्नरः। नापदं प्राप्नुयात् कांचिदं दीर्घमायुश्च विन्दति। सर्वत्र जयमाप्नोति न कदाचित् पराजयम्॥
en: He need not have any fear from his enemy and he will never become sonless. He will never meet with any danger and he will live a long life. Everywhere he will get victories and seldom defeat.

sa: ततो धनंजयो बाणैः सर्वानेव महारथान्। आयाद् विनिघ्नन् कौरव्यान् दहन कक्षमिवानलः।। १२
en: Then Dhananjaya advanced slaying all the mighty car-warriors of the Kauravas, with his arrows, just as fire advances consuming heaps of straw and fuel.

sa: युक्ता यदा जानपदा भिक्षन्ते ब्राह्मणा इव। अभीक्ष्णं भिक्षुरूपेण राजानं मन्ति तादृशाः॥
en: When all the subjects of a king are compelled by distress to live like Brahmanas, by begging, such mendicancy brings destruction upon the king.

sa: विदुर उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्वा स्वयंभुवे। यथा संसारगहनं वदन्ति परमर्षयः॥
en: Vidura said “Having saluted the Self-create, I will obey your command by telling, you how the great sages speak of the wilderness of life.

sa: तं प्रयान्तं कुरुश्रेष्ठं स्वान् भ्रातृन् द्रोणतापितान्। सुशर्मा भ्रातृभिः सार्धं युद्धार्थी पृष्ठतोऽन्वयात्॥
en: Beholding that foremost of the Kurus make towards his brothers afflicted sore by Drona, king Susarman with his brothers followed him, desirous of battle.

sa: धनात् कुलं प्रभवति धनाद् धर्म प्रवर्धते। नाधनस्यास्त्ययं लोको न परः पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Wealth begets family prestige. wealth multiples one's religious merit. He who is without wealth has neither this world, nor the next,O foremost of men.

sa: कच्चिद् बुद्धिं दृढां कृत्वा चरस्यारण्यकं विधिम्। कच्चिद् वधूश्च गान्धारी न शोकेनाभिभूयते॥
en: Do you practise the ordinances of forest-life after having made your heart firin? Does my daughter-in-law, Gandhari, suffer herself to be overwhelmed by grief?

sa: अनित्यं यौवनं रूपं जीवितं द्रव्यसंचयः। आरोग्यं प्रियसंवासो गृध्येत् तत्र न पण्डितः॥
en: Youth, beauty, life, hoarded riches, health, association with those that are loved, these all are fickle. One endued with wisdom should never covet them.

sa: वश्यां कुमारी बलतो ये तां समुपभुजते। एते पापस्य कर्तारस्तमस्यन्थे च शेरते॥
en: Those persons who have sexual intercourse with a maiden, by force are considered as perpetrators of sin. They have to sink in darkest hell.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच दश वर्षसहस्राणि यत्रसायंगृहो मुनिः। व्यचरस्त्वं पुरा कृष्ण पर्वते गन्धमादने॥
en: Arjuna said: O Krishna, in the days of yore, you had wandered on the Gandhamadana mountain for ten thousand years as a Fatrashayanagriha Rishi.

sa: नहुषस्तां ततो दृष्ट्वा सस्मितो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। स्वागतं ते वरारोहे किं करोमि शुचिस्मिते॥
en: Nahusha surprised at seeing her, spoke these words-Welcome to you, O you of beautiful hips, what shall I do, O you of lovely smiles?

sa: भीमस्य पादौ कृत्वा तु स्व उत्सङ्गे ततोऽबला। पर्यमर्दत् संहृष्टा कल्याणी मृदुपाणिना॥
en: That weak and blessed one (the Rakshasas woman), thereupon taking up Bhima's feet on her lap, began to press them with her soft hands.

sa: भक्तिमन्तो हि मे रक्ष्या इत्येतेनापि हेतुना। भक्तोऽयं परया भक्त्या मामित्येव महाभुजा ममापि भक्तिरुत्पन्ना स त्वं कुरु वचो मम॥
en: And for this further reason that all my devotees should be protected protected by me. Considering, O mighty-amed one, that this person is a great devotee to me, I have been inclined to revere you. Therefore accept my advice.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच नासुहृत् परमं मन्त्रं नारदार्हति वेदितुम्। अपण्डितो वापि सुहृत् पण्डितो वाप्यनात्मवान्॥
en: Once on a time Vasudeva said-Neither an illiterate and foolish friend, nor a learned friend of fickle mind, deserves, O Narada, to know one's secret counsels.

sa: यच्च भूतं सम्भजते ये च भूतास्तदन्वयाः। अधर्मस्थे हि नृपतौ सर्वे शोचन्ति पार्थिव॥
en: All creatures adore the king. All creatures are the children of the king. If, therefore, O monarch, the king becomes unrighteous, all creatures meet with ruin.

sa: मावमंस्थाः परान् राजन्नस्ति वीर्यं नरे नरे। समं तेजस्त्वया चैव विशिष्टं वा नरेश्वर॥
en: O king, do not disregard others; velour exists in every man. O king of men, there are men whose velour is equal or superior to yours.

sa: यदा रजस्वलां कृष्णां दुःशासनवशे स्थिताम्। सभायांन प्राहसः कर्ण क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When you laughed at Draupadi while she, spare dressed and in her season, stood before the court at Dusasana's will where was this virtue of yours?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच असिद्धानुनये कृष्णे कुरुभ्यः पाण्डवान् गते। अभिगम्य पृथां क्षत्ता शनैः शोचन्निवाब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The object of Krishna having proved vrsuccessful and he having left the Kurus, the Kshattri having approached Pritha said to her slowly and sadly,

sa: वासुदेव उवाच सामरेष्वपि लोकेषु सर्वेषु न तथाविधः। शरासनधरः कश्चिद् यथा पार्थो धनजंयः॥
en: Krishna said In all the worlds, including the regions of celestials, there is no such wielder of bow who can equal Dhananjaya the son of Pritha.

sa: युक्त एव हि भाग्येन ध्रुवमुत्पद्यते नरः। स तथाऽऽकृष्यते तेन न यथा स्वयमिच्छति॥
en: Surely man is born subject to the decrees of Destiny; and so he is compelled by it to do what he does not at all desire.

sa: यदि श्रोतुमिहार्हामि न रहस्यं च ते यदि। छिन्धि मे संशयं देव प्रपन्नायाभियाचते॥
en: If I am fit to hear the cause, and if it is no secret, remove, O god, my doubt, for I beg this। favour from you.

sa: मन्ये तथा तद् भवितेति सूत यथा क्षत्ता प्राह वचः पुरा माम्। असंशयं भविता युद्धमेतद् गते काले पाण्डवानां यथोक्तम्॥
en: O charioteer, I think it is now almost certain what Vidura had told me of old, that undoubtedly you would happen, a most fearful battle with the Pandavas just after the expire of the said period of thirteen years.

sa: धिग् बलं भीमसेनस्य धिक् पार्थस्य च पौरुषम् यत्र दुर्योधनः कृष्ण मुहूर्तमपि जीवति॥
en: O Krishna, fie to the strength of Bhima and to the prowess to Partha (Arjuna) for Duryodhana lived for even a moment (after what he did).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तु वाजी समुद्रान्तां पर्येत्य वसुधामिमाम्। निवृत्तोऽभिमुखो राजन् येन वारणसाह्वयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The (sacrificial) horse, having wandered over the entire Earth bounded by the ocean, then ceased and turned his face toward the city of Hastinapur.

sa: रजसा तमसा व्याप्ता द्योतिताः प्रभया पुनः। अस्त्राणां कवचानां च मणीनां च महात्मनाम्॥
en: (Hitherto) buried in darkness and dust, again blazed with the lustre (of those lamps). The lustre of weapons, armours and gems belonging to the high-souled (combatants).

sa: न तस्याः सूक्ष्ममप्यस्ति यद् गात्रे रूपसम्पदा। नियुक्ता यत्र वा दृष्टिर्न सज्जति निरीक्षताम्॥
en: There was not the minutest part of her body which by its wealth of beauty did not rivet the gaze of the beholder directed towards it.

sa: बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो मेघानां गर्जतामिव। द्रवतां सादिनां चैव गजानां च विशाम्पते। ३६॥
en: And O lord of the earth, O Bharata, there arose a tumultuous uproar, like the roar of the clouds, as the horse-man and elephants rushed against.

sa: स तु वेगवता मुक्तो बाणो वज्राशनिस्वनः। विवेश सहसा कर्ण सव्ये पार्श्वे महारथम्॥
en: Discharged with great velocity and making a sound like that of a thunder bolt the arrow suddenly pierced the great car-warrior Karna on his left side.

sa: रूपं ज्योतिः शब्द आकाशवायुः स्पर्शः स्वाद्यं सलिलं गन्ध उर्वी। कालो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म च ब्राह्मणाश्च त्वत्सम्भूतं स्थास्नु चरिष्णु चेदम्॥
en: All acts done for gratifying Indra, Yama, Varuna, Kubera, the Pitris and Tashtri and the Moon, all are done to propitiate you. Form and light, sound and the etherial space, wind and touch, taste and water, scent and earth.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच कुन्तीमातर्ममाप्येतद् रोचते यद् वयं जले। सुहज रनवृतः पार्थ विहरेम यथासुखम्॥
en: Krishna said : O son of Kunti, this is also my wish. O Partha, let us sport with our friends in the waters( of the Yamuna).

sa: ग्रहणे धर्मराजस्य सर्वोपायेन वर्तते। न च मे गमने कृत्यं तादृक् पार्षत विद्यते॥
en: Is ever watchful for capturing the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. O son of Prisata, when I am gone, there should be no other duty of yours.

sa: मा वृथा गर्ज कौन्तेय शारदाभ्रमिवाजलम्। दर्शयस्व बलं युद्धे यावत् तत् तेऽद्य विद्यते॥
en: Do not, O son of Kunti, roar uselessly in this way like autumnal clouds shorn of water. Display all the strength you posses in battle now.

sa: येषां पुरोगमा विप्रा येषां ब्रह्म परं बलम्। अतिथिप्रियास्तथा पौरास्ते वै स्वर्गजितो नृपाः॥
en: Those kings, who yield to Brahmanas and whose might depends upon that of the Brahmanas, and whose subjects are always hospitable, always succeed in gaining heaven.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच ब्रह्मशानेन्द्रवरुणानवहद् यः पुरा रथः। तमास्थाय गतौ कृष्णौ न तयोर्विद्यते भयम्॥
en: Bhima said Riding on the chariot formerly ridden by Bharata, Ishana, Indra and Varuna, Arjuna and Krishna have proceeded to battle! They can have no fear.

sa: विष्णुरुवाच जानामि ते भयं शक्र दैत्येन्द्रान्नरकात् ततः। ऐन्द्रं प्रार्थयते स्थानं तप:सिद्धेन कर्मणा॥
en: Vishnu said: “O Sakra, I know your fear originates from the lord of the Daityas, Naraka. By his successful asceticism he desires to obtain Indra's kingdom.

sa: शल्य उवाच एवमेतत् करिष्यामि यथा मां सम्प्रभाषसे। यच्चान्यदपि शक्ष्यामि तत् करिष्याम्यहं तव।॥
en: Shalya said I shall do this, even as you dictate to me; and whatever else that I am able to do I shall do for you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच महर्षेः कीर्तने तस्य भीष्मः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्। धर्ममर्थं च कामं च त्रीनेतान् योऽनुपश्यति॥ अर्थमर्थानुबन्धं च धर्मं धर्मानुबन्धनम्। कामं कामानुबन्धं च विपरीतान् पृथक् पृथक्॥ यो विचिन्त्य धिया धीरो व्यवस्यति स बुद्धिमान्। तदिदं धर्मयुक्तं च हितं चैव कुलस्य नः॥ उक्तं भवत्या यच्छ्रेयस्तन्मह्यं रोचते भृशम्।
en: Vaishampayana said : When the great Rishi was the mentioned, Bhishma with joined hands said. "That man is truly intelligent who fixes his eyes judiciously on Dharma, Artha and Kama and who, after reflecting with patience, acts in such a way as virtue (Dharma) may lead to future virtue, profit (Artha) to future profit and pleasure (Kama) to future pleasure. Therefore, that which has been said by you and that which, besides being beneficial to us is consistent with virtue, is certainly the best advice and it has my full approval."

sa: किमर्थं मां प्राकृतवदुपप्रेक्षसि संसदि। न खल्वहमिदं शून्ये रौमि किं न शृणोषि मे॥
en: Why do you treat me before all these men like an ordinary woman? I am certainly not crying in the wilderness. Do you not hear me?

sa: भीष्म उवाच पुनरेव तु तं शक्रः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्। निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागं प्रव्याहाराय भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Again, laughing at Vali who was sighing like a snake, Shakra addressed him for saying something more painful than what he had said before.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अत्रैव च सरस्वत्या गीतं परपुरंजय। पृष्टया मुनिना वीर शृणु तायेणधीमता॥
en: Markandeya said : O conqueror of hostile cities, O hero in this connection, Sarasvati, when asked by that intelligent Rishi Tarkshya, said (the following). Hear it.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति संहृष्टे प्रद्युम्ने पाण्डुनन्दन। विष्ठितं तद् बलं वीर युयुधे च यथासुखम्॥
en: O son of Pandu, O hero, when Pradyumna thus spoke with a cheerful heart, the Yadava warriors stood on the field and began to fight cheerfully.

sa: विद्वतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा वानराणामितस्ततः। कुम्भकर्णेन सुग्रीवं गृहीतं चापि वानरम्॥ हनूमांश्चिन्तयामास मतिमान्मारुतात्मजः। एवं गृहीते सुग्रीवे किं कर्तव्यं मया भवेत्॥
en: Then Hanumān, the shrewd son of Maruta, finding the whole host of monkeys scattered in all directions, as well as Sugrīva captured by Kumbhakarņa bethought himself—“What ought to be done by me now that our king has been captured?

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथा विन्ध्यो न वर्धते। अगस्त्यस्य प्रभावेण यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: Thus have I narrated to you, as you asked me to do, why Vindhya does not increase its bulk on account of the prowess of Agastya.

sa: तथा शांतनवो भीष्मः सत्यसंधो महाव्रतः। प्रत्याख्याय पुरा राज्यं न स जातु ग्रहीष्यति॥
en: And the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, is of rigid vows and devoted to truth; having son relinquished the kingdom before, he will never accept it now.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु यो राज्यं धर्मनित्योऽर्हते नृपः। सोऽयं भूमौ परिश्रान्तः शेते प्राकृतवत् कथम्॥
en: The ever virtuous (Yudhisthira) who deserves to be the king of the three worlds, now sleeps on the ground, fatigued and tired like on ordinary being.

sa: भरतस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वामृतमयं यथा। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे रामः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ उवाच च शुभं वाक्यं कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम्। प्रीतोऽस्मि परितुष्टोऽस्मि तवाद्य वचनेऽनघ।।१७
en: Hearing those sweet accents of Bharata, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, attained to incomparable delight, and addressed the enhancer of Kaikeyi's delight with kind words, saying: O you freed from sins, I have been greatly delighted with you.

sa: व्रजे वाप्यथवारण्ये यत्र सन्ति बहुश्रुताः। तत् तन्नगरमित्याहुः पार्थ तीर्थं च तद् भवेत्॥
en: O son of Pritha, whether it be a forest or a pasture ground where learned Brahmanas live is called a city. It is also a Tirtha.

sa: मयूरस्य वने नूनं रक्षसा न हृता प्रिया॥ तस्मान्नृत्यति रम्येषु वनेषु सह कान्तया।
en: Surely the Rākşasa has not brought my dear one in this forest of peacocks and therefore they dance with their mates in this picturesque forest land.

sa: जनस्थानसमीपे च समाक्रम्य खरस्वनाः। विस्वरान् विविधान् नादान् मांसादा मृगपक्षिणः।।।। व्याजहुरभिदीप्तायां दिशि वै भैरवस्वनम्। अशिवं यातुधानानां शिवा घोरा महास्वनाः॥
en: And beasts and birds having shrill voices, living on flesh, remaining near Janasthāna, emitted various dissonant notes. And in the quarter lighted up by the sun, fierce jackals having mighty voices, in dreadful cries presaged evil to the Rākşasas.

sa: तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि शाम्यन्ति क्षत्रियाणां युधिष्ठिर। समुदीर्णान्यजेयानि तेजांसि च बलानि च॥ ब्रह्मवीर्ये मृदुभूते क्षत्रवीर्ये च दुर्बले। दुष्टेषु सर्ववर्णेषु ब्राह्मणान् प्रति सर्वशः॥ ये तत्र युद्ध कुर्वन्ति त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः। ब्राह्मणान् परिरक्षन्तो धर्मामात्मानमेव च॥ मनस्विनो मन्युमन्तः पुण्य श्लोका भवन्ति ते। ब्राह्मणार्थं हि सर्वेषां शस्त्रग्रहणमिष्यते॥
en: Thus, O Yudhishthira, the energy and might of Kshatriya, however great and irresistible be, are destroyed as soon as they are directed against the Brahmanas. When the power of the Brahmanas becomes mild, when that of the Kshatriyas is weakened, when all men ill-treat the Brahmanas, those strong-minded persons, who moved by righteous indignation, then fight, casting off all fear of death, for protecting the Brahmanas. morality, and their own selves,-succeed in winning high regions of bliss hereafter. All persons should fight for the sake of Brahmanas.

sa: हृता मृता वा वैदेही भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी। न धर्मस्त्रायते सीतां ह्रियमाणा महावने॥
en: Poor Sītā must have been either dead, carried away by them or devoured. Virtue did not save her from being carried away in this mighty forest.

sa: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्ति लभते पराम्॥
en: Becoming one with Brahma, and obtaining tranquility in spirit, man grieves not and desires not. Seeing all beings alike, he obtains the highest devotion to Me.

sa: रोषणः सर्वभूतानां सूक्ष्मेऽप्यपकृते कृते। परिभाषां च मे श्रुत्वा को नु दद्यात् प्रतिश्रयम्॥
en: He becomes wroth with cvery one if he finds even the slightest transgression! Hearing this about my nature, who is there who will give me refuge?

sa: विमुक्तं वासुदेवं च श्रुत्वा रामं च पाण्डवः। समानीयाब्रवीद् भ्रातृन् किं करिष्याम इत्युत॥
en: The son of Pandu, hearing that only Vasudeva and Rama had escaped alive, summoned his brothers and consulted with them as to what they should do.

sa: आदाय च न शक्नोमि पुत्रांस्तरितुमात्मना। न च त्यक्तुमहं शक्ता हृदयं दूयतीव मे॥
en: I myself am incapable of escapingspecially taking all these (my children) with me. I am incapable of abandoning them; my heart is distressed for their sake.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। नारदस्य च संवादमृषेर्नारायणस्य च॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Narada and the Rishi Narayana.

sa: देवा मनुष्याः पितरो गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसाः। आसन् सर्वे मम वशे नत् सर्वं वेत्थ वासव॥
en: In days gone by, that gods, men, the Pitris, the Gandharvas, the Nagas, and the Rakshasas, were all under my control. You know this, O Vasava.

sa: सारथिर्यस्य वार्ष्णेयो गाण्डीवं यस्य कार्मुकम्। तं चेद्धन्तासि राधेन त्वं नो राजा भविष्यसि॥
en: O son of Radha, you will be our king if you can slay him today who has Krishna for his driver and Gandiva for his bow.

sa: अभ्यद्रवत् सुसंक्रुद्धो रणे शैनेयमच्युतम्। नैव दैवं न गान्धर्व नासुरं न च राक्षसम्॥
en: And wrathfully rushed against the undeteriorating grandson of Sini in that encounter. Neither among the celestials, the Gandharvas, the Asuras, the Uragas, nor among the Rakshas.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो येषामर्थाय संजय। त्यक्तारः संयुगे प्राणान् किं तेषामजितं युधि॥
en: O Sanjaya, what cannot be vanquished by them for whose interests these and other such numerous (heroes) are ever ready to sacrifice their lives in battle?

sa: कृष्णो वापि भवेल्लोके पार्थो वापि धनुर्धरः। शैनेयो वा नरव्याघ्र चतुर्थस्तु न विद्यते॥
en: (To achieve such feats) there is no fourth to be seen, besides Krishna, the bowman Partha and that most exalted of men, the grandson of Sini.

sa: भीष्म उवाच रथेनेन्द्रः प्रयातो वै सार्धं देवगणैः पुरा। ददर्शाथाग्रतो वृत्रं धिष्ठितं पर्वतोपमम्॥
en: Bhishma said-In days of yore, Indra, accompanied by the celestial army, proceeded on his car, and saw the Asura Vritra stationed before him like a mountain.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अजिनानि विधु-वन्तः करकांश्च द्विजर्षभाः। ऊचुस्ते भीर्न कर्तव्या वयं योत्स्यामहे परान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Those best of Brahmanas (present there), shaking their deer-skins and coconut shell water pots, exclaimed, “Fear not; we shall fight with the foes."

sa: ततः संवत्सरे पूर्णे यदासौ जपतां वरः। नापश्यद् दुष्कृतं किंचित् पृथायाः सौहृदे रतः॥
en: When on the expiration of a whole year, that best of devotees could not find any cause to be dissatisfied with Pritha, devoted to his service.

sa: केशिन्युवाच स्वागतं ते मनुष्येन्द्र कुशलं ते ब्रवीम्यहम्। दमयन्त्या वचः साधु निबोध पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Keshini said: O best of men, O excellent of persons, you are welcome! I wish you prosperity! Now listen to the words of Damayanti with attention.

sa: यत्कृते चासि निकृतो दुःखेन महता नल। विषेण स मदीयेन त्वयि दुःखं निवत्स्यति॥
en: As I have done this, O Nala, the person, by whom have you been cast into great distress, will dwell within yourself, oppressed by my venom."

sa: वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः। शुकस्य च महातेजाः सारणस्य च धीमतः॥
en: And (then) the mighty monkey darting up, set fire to Vajradanştra's; and (then) that highly energetic one set fire to Suka's and to the intelligent Sārana's.

sa: क्व नु त्वं कितवच्छित्त्वा वस्त्रार्धं प्रस्थितो मम। उत्सृज्य विपिने सुप्तामनुरक्तां प्रियां प्रिय॥
en: "O gambler, O dear one, where have you gone, tearing off half my garment and forsaking me, your devoted and beloved wife, asleep in the forest.

sa: सुसंरब्धोऽपि रामाणां न कुर्यादप्रियं नरः। रतिं प्रीतिं च धर्मं च तास्वायत्तमवेक्ष्य हि॥
en: No man, even in anger, should even do any thing that is disagreeable to his wife; for happiness, joy, virtue and everything depend on the wife.

sa: अहं वः प्रतिजानामि न गमिष्याम्यहं पुरीम् । इहैव प्रायमासिष्ये श्रेयो मरणमेव मे॥
en: I vow before you, to the palace I will never repair. At this very spot will I fast for death; as death is good for me.

sa: संजय उवाच हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथा वृत्तं महारणे। शुश्रूषस्व स्थिरो भूत्वा दुराचरितमात्मनः॥
en: Sanjaya said I will relate to you faithfully all that took place in that terrible encounter. Listen calmly to (the consequences of) your own culpable conduct.

sa: तस्य स्त्रीणां सहस्राणि चत्वार्यासन् परिग्रहे। एकैव च सुता सुभ्रः सुकन्या नाम भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, with him were four thousand women, all wedded to him. There was also with him his daughter of beautiful brows, named Sukanya.

sa: मातापित्रोः प्रजायन्ते पुत्राः साधारणाः कवे॥ तेषां पिता यथा स्वामी तथा माता न संशयः। विधानविहितः सत्यं यथा मे प्रथमः सुतः॥ विचित्रवीर्यो ब्रह्मर्षे तथा मेऽवरजः सुतः। यथैव पितृतो भीष्मस्तथा त्वमपि मातृतः॥ भ्राता विचित्रवीर्यस्य यथा वा पुत्र मन्यसे। अयं शान्तनवः सत्यं पालयन् सत्यविक्रमः॥ बुद्धिं न कुरुतेऽपत्ये तथा राज्यानुशासने। स त्वं व्यपेक्षया भ्रातुः संतानाय कुलस्य च॥
en: She then said, "O Kavi, (learned man), the sons derive their birth from both the father and the mother. There is no doubt that their proprietors are both the father and the mother. You are my eldest son according to the ordinances. O Brahmarshi, Vichitravirya was my youngest son. As he was the brother of Bhishma by father's side, so you are by the mother's side. This is my opinion, I do not know what is your opinion, I do not know what is your opinion. This Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, who is devoted to truth, does not, for the sake of truth, wish to beget children or to rule the kingdom.

sa: तं भीमसेनोऽनुययौ रथेन पृष्ठे रक्षन् पाण्डवमेकवीरः। तौ राजपुत्रौ त्वरितौ रथाभ्यां कर्णाय यातावरिभिर्विषक्तौ॥
en: The redoubtable Bhimasena followed Arjuna on his car guarding the rear and both the princes fighting their way on their respective cars advanced fast towards Karna.

sa: क्षमा प्रशस्यते लोके न तु पापोऽर्हति क्षमाम्॥ क्षमावन्तं हि पापात्मा जितोऽयमिति मन्यते।
en: Forgiveness is a praise worthy virtue, buy sinful wretches do not deserve it. A wicked fellow regards him who shows forgiveness as powerless (lit : conquered).

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित्केकयो नृपः। स्वगुरुं प्रेषयामास राघवाय महात्मने॥ गाय॑मङ्गिरसः पुत्रं ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभम्। दश चाश्वसहस्राणि प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम्॥ कम्बलानि च रत्नानि चित्रवस्त्रमथोत्तमम्। रामाय प्रददौ राजा शुभान्याभरणानि च॥
en: Once on a time Yudhajit, the king of Kekaya, sent to the high-souled Rāma, Gārgya— son of his own preceptor Angiras-a Brāhmaṇa saint of unmitigated prowess; and with him he sent, as tokens of affections, gifts of ten thousand horses, numberless blankets various jewels, diverse clothes and well washed coverlets.

sa: स तमानर्च राजेन्द्र भ्रातृभिः सहितः प्रभुः। द्विजानां च परां पूजां चक्रे नृपतिसत्तमः॥
en: O king of kings, that foremost of kings, that lord, then with his brothers offered highest worship to the Brahmanas; and they also worshipped him (Rama).

sa: पम्पातीररुहाश्चेमे संसिक्ता मधुगन्धिनः। मालतीमल्लिकापद्मकरवीराश्च पुष्पिताः।७६ ।। केतक्यः सिन्दुवाराश्च वासन्त्यश्च सुपुष्पिताः। माधव्यो गन्धपूर्णाश्च कुन्दगुल्माश्च सर्वशः॥ चिरिबिल्वा मधूकाश्च वञ्जुला बकुलास्तथा। चम्पकास्तिलकाश्चैव नागवृक्षाश्च पुष्पिताः॥ पद्मकाश्चैव शोभन्ते नीलाशोकाश्च पुष्पिताः। लोध्राश्च गिरिपृष्ठेषु सिंहकेसरपिञ्जराः। ७९।।
en: These fragrant Mālatis, Mallikäs, Karavīras and lotuses, growing on the banks of Pampā, and fostered by Pampā's water, and Ketakis, Sinduvāras, Basantis in full blossom, the climber Madhavi full of fragrance, and Jasmin shrubs groves on every side. Ciribilvas, Madhukas, Vañjulas, Bakulas, Campakas, Tilakas, Nāgas, Padmakas, blue Asokas, and yellow Lodhras on the hills like to manes of a lion, are in flowers.

sa: स्थैर्यमात्ममनःशौचमानृशंस्यमथार्जवम्। विक्रमश्चैव धैर्यं च सुग्रीवे नोपपद्यते॥
en: Firmness, and mental sanctity, mercy, candour, prowess, and patience, are not in Sugriva.

sa: स विनिर्जित्य राज्ञस्तान् करे च विनिवेश्य तु। धनान्यादाय सर्वेभ्यो रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: Having thus vanquished and subjugated many kings and countries, he exacted tributes from them all, and (he thus) obtained much wealth and many gems and jewels.

sa: न हि पाण्डुसुता राजन् ससैन्याः सपदानुगाः। रक्षन्ति समरे प्राणान् कौरवा वापि संयुगे॥
en: Neither the sons of Pandu, O king, with their soldiers and followers, nor the Kauravas pay any the least head to their lives in that battle.

sa: ईदृग्रुपमहं मन्ये पार्थस्य युधि विग्रहम्। न हि शक्योऽर्जुनो जेतुं युधि सेन्द्रैः सुरासरैः॥
en: Methinks, to assail Partha is just like this. Even the very gods and demons united together with Indra at their head cannot discomfit Arjuna in battle.

sa: स मध्यं प्राप्य सैन्यानां सर्वाः प्रविचरन् दिशः। जाता ह्मभवदन्येषां न त्रातव्यः कथञ्चन॥
en: Penetrating into the heart of the (hostile) host, resisted in all directions, he became the protector of all others and had no need of protecting himself.

sa: परेषां तन्ममाचक्ष्व यदि वेत्थ परंतप। पञ्च ते भ्रातरः सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ सात्यकिः॥ परेषां सप्त ये राजन् योधाः सारं बलं मतम्। अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये भीष्मद्रोणकृपादयः॥
en: If you know any among the enemies (who will) thus tell me of him, O subduer of enemies. The five brothers along with Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki these seven warriors whom you consider to be the best among the enemies and the accomplished warriors on our side are Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and others.

sa: तच्च मे कृन्तते मर्म यन्न तस्य शिरो मया। निषादविषये क्षिप्तं जयद्रथशिरो यथा।॥
en: This fact that I have not thrown his head, like that of Jayadratha, into the omissions of the Nisadhas, is corroding he core of my heart.

sa: विज्ञाप्य तु ममैतद्धियद्वदाम्यागतस्पृहः। तद्भवद्भिर्मम कृते कर्तव्यमनुकम्पया॥
en: Whatever I would like to submit before you, may kindly be carried out.

sa: उत्पातांस्ताननादृत्य राक्षसा बलदर्पिताः॥ यान्त्येव न निवर्तन्ते मृत्युपाशवपाशिताः। माल्यवांश्च सुमाली च माली च सुमहाबलः॥ पुरःसरा राक्षसानां ज्वलिता इव पावकाः।
en: But fast bound with the noose of Death, the Raksasas, proud of their strength, disregarding these omens, march on, and do not stay their course, Mälyavān and Sumāli possessed of prodigious strength, going before the Raksasas, like flaming fires.

sa: राक्षसास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा लङ्कायां परिचक्रमुः। अनुगेहमवस्थाय विहारशयनेषु च। उद्यानेषु च रक्षांसि चोदयन्तो ह्यभीतवत्॥
en: Hearing his words, the envoys began to range Lankā; and going to every house, they fearlessly collected the Rākṣasas from places of sport, bedrooms, and gardens.

sa: एवमुक्तो धनुर्भीम परामृश्य महाबलः। ससर्ज निशितान्बाणानिन्द्रजित्समितिजयः॥
en: Thus addressed, the mighty IndrajitConqueror of enemies-stretching his dreadful bow, showered sharpened shafts.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु कोऽन्योऽस्ति यो न जानाति मे बलम्। भ्रातरं येन निर्जित्य विमानमिदमाहृतम्॥
en: What other man is there in these three regions that know not the might of me, who, conquering my brother, has got possession of this car.

sa: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। हर्षयन्मैथिली वाक्यमुवाचेदं महामतिः॥
en: Hearing these words, the high-minded Hanumăn, the son of Maruta, pleasing Maithili said.

sa: दृष्टा सीता महाबाहो सौमित्रे पश्य तत्त्वतः। अभिगम्य यथा सर्वे पिबन्ति मधु वानराः॥
en: O you of mighty arms, O son of Sumitra, forsooth they have beheld Sītā, since the monkeys, just on their return, have engaged in drinking honey.

sa: देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत्। यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतद्विराजते॥
en: The persons of celestials appear splendid as does the person of the Raksasa-chief.

sa: ततो भेरीसहस्रं तु युगपत्समहन्यत। मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानामसक्तानां समन्ततः॥
en: Then they simultaneously sounded a thousand kettle-drums beaten with sticks of polished gold.

sa: यदन्यथा भवेदेतद् द्वौ मासौ जीवितं मम। न मां द्रक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थो म्रिये साहमनाथवत्॥
en: Or else there remain two months more of my me. Rāghava shall not see me and I shall quit my life like one having no husband.

sa: यदर्थं वानरं सैन्यं समानीतमिदं मया। सुग्रीवश्च कृतो राज्ये निहत्वा वालिनं रणे।। यदर्थं सागरः क्रान्तः सेतुर्बद्धश्च सागरे॥ सोऽयमद्य रणे पापा आपश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः। चक्षुर्विषयमागत्य नायं जीवितमर्हति॥
