en: He for whom I have brought over the monkey-forces, made Sugriva king, slaying Vali in battle, for whom I have crossed the ocean and constructed a bridge over the deep-the same has been come at by me in conflict, and the same has come within the range of my vision.

sa: हत्वा च समरे रौद्रं रावणं सहबान्धवम् ॥ राघवस्त्वां वरारोहे स्वपुरी नयिता ध्रुवम्।
en: And slaying in conflict the terrible Rāvaņa, with his kith and kin, Rāghava, in sooth, O excellent damsel, shall take you back to his own city.

sa: गमने च कृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य वरवर्णिनी॥ विवर्धमानं च हि मामुवाच जनकात्मजा। अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदभाषिणी॥ ममोत्पतनसम्भ्रान्ता शोकवेगसमाहता। मामुवाच ततः सीता सभाग्योऽसि महाकपे॥ यद् द्रक्ष्यसि महाबाहुं रामं कमललोचनम्। लक्ष्मणं च महाबाहुं देवरं मे यशस्विनम्॥
en: Thereupon beholding me ready to depart and increase in bulk and about to leap up in the welkin, Sītā, the daughter of the king Janaka, poorly, bathed in tears, overwhelmed with sorrow and having her voice choked with grief, saying 'Blessed are you O great monkey, since you shall behold the large-armed and the lotuseyed Ráma and the highly famed Lakşmaņa, my lord's younger brother.

sa: देवो न मानुषो वा त्वमनुक्रोशादिहागतः। प्रियाख्यानस्य ते सौम्य ददामि ब्रुवतः प्रियम्।॥ गवां शतसहस्रं च ग्रामाणां च शतं परम्। सकुण्डलाः शुभाचारा भार्याः कन्यास्तु षोडश॥ हेमवर्णाः सुनासोरूः शशिसौम्याननाः स्त्रियः। सर्वाभरणसंपन्नाः संपन्ना कुलजातिभिः॥
en: He said, Are you a man or god who have kindly come here? O gentle one, I shall confer upon you, who have communicated to me this pleasant tidings, hundreds and thousands of kine, hundreds of prosperous villages, sixteen young wives, pious, wearing excellent Kundalas, golden-hued, having beautiful noses and breast, having mor i like countenances, decked with all ornaments and born of respectable families.

sa: पुरा च यदहं वीर स्पृष्टा गात्रेषु रक्षसा। तत्राहं किं करिष्यामि कालेनोपनिपीडिता॥ गच्छ त्वं कपिशार्दूल यत्र तौ नृपतेः सुतौ।
en: And although before this I was touched by the demon, O hero, it was because I could not help otherwise subject as I was to circumstances. Do you yourself repair, O foremost of monkeys, where those two princes are.

sa: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः। नहि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः॥
en: While I have crossed over the main-what of these mighty heroes? The leading heroes are never sent on a mission but only those of inferior merit.

sa: कस्मात्त्वं मां विहायेह कृपणां गन्तुमिच्छसि॥ दीनां विलपती मन्दां किं च मां नाभिभाषसे।
en: Why did you wish to go leaving me behind who have been rendered poorly? Why did you not welcome me, unfortunate and poor, who am bewailing?

sa: यो ब्राह्ममस्त्रं वेदांश्च वेद वेदविदां वरः। स त्वां दाशरथी रामो देवि कौशलमब्रवीत्॥
en: O worshipful dame, Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, the master of the Vedas, and the foremost of those conversant with Vedas has enquired of your welfare.

sa: संरुद्धस्तैस्तु परितो विधमे राक्षसं बलम्। शक्नुयां न तु सम्प्राप्तं परं पारं महोदधेः॥
en: Being surrounded by them on all sides, If I do kill that host of demons, tired, I shall not be able to bound over the main.

sa: राज्यं वा त्रिषु लोकेषु सीता वा जनकात्मजा। त्रैलोक्यराज्यं सकलं सीताया नाप्नुयात् कलाम्॥
en: If the kingdom over the three worlds and the daughter of Janaka be compared together, the former is not equal to one hundredth part of Sītā.

sa: अथवा दुर्बलः क्लीबो बलं धर्मोऽनुवर्तते। दुर्बलो हृतमर्यादो न सेव्य इति मे मतिः॥
en: Or itself feeble and impotent, it take refuge in manliness. And being powerless and bereft of dignity, it should, I deem, by no means be followed.

sa: ततः प्रबोधिता भेर्यञ्चन्द्रपाण्डुरपुष्कराः। हेमकोणैरभिहता राक्षसानां समन्ततः॥
en: Then awoke the kettle-drums, having moonlike pale faces-sounded by means of golden sticks.

sa: नैव तेषां गतिर्भीमा न तेजो न पराक्रमः॥ न मतिर्न बलोत्साहो न रूपपरिकल्पनम्।
en: Their speed is not dreadful, nor their energy, nor their prowess, nor their intelligence, nor their strength, nor their courage, nor their capacity to change shapes.

sa: कन्यापितृत्वं दुःखं हि सर्वेषां मानकाङ्क्षिणाम्। न ज्ञायते च कः कन्यां वरयेदिति कन्यके॥
en: The being father to a daughter is misery to every one that seekes honour. O daughter, one does not know who shall ask for one's daughter.

sa: तत्कृते च वयं सर्वे यन्त्रिता धर्मबुद्धयः। त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके॥
en: But desirous of acquiring religious merit, we are striving our best in your interests. My daughter, you are finished with every perfection like to Śrī herself.

sa: भग्नानां वो न पश्यामि परिक्रम्य महीमिमाम्। स्थानं सर्वे निवर्तध्वं किं प्राणान्परिरक्षथ ॥
en: Desist, you monkeys. Going round this Earth place find I none where you may rest. Stop you all. What is the need of preserving your lives.

sa: तान्समीक्ष्याङ्गदो भग्नान्वानरानिदमब्रवीत्। अवतिष्ठत युध्यामो निवर्तध्वं प्लवंगमाः॥
en: Seeing the monkeys break down, Angada addressed them, saying, “Stay we shall fight.

sa: छिन्ना भिन्ना प्रभिन्ना वा दीप्ता वाग्नौ प्रदीपिता। रावणं नोपतिष्ठेयं किं प्रलापेन वश्चिरम्॥
en: What more shall I speak to you, I shall never consent to Rāvana's prayer, I might be rent from limb to limb or burnt in fire.

sa: आतॊ वा यदि वा दृप्तः परेषां शरणं गतः। अरिः प्राणान्परित्यज्य रक्षितव्यः कृतात्मना॥
en: If an enemy, proud or terrified, seek shelter in affright, he should be saved by a great man even at the risk of his own life.

sa: एषा ते हृदयं भित्त्वा शक्तिर्लोहितलक्षणा। मद्बाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टा प्राणानादाय यास्यति॥ इत्येवमुक्त्वा तां शक्तिमष्टघण्टां महास्वनाम्। मयेन मायाविहिताममोघां शत्रुघातिनीम्॥ लक्ष्मणाय समुद्दिश्य ज्वलन्तीमिव तेजसा। रावणः परमवद्धश्चिक्षपे च ननाद च॥ सा क्षिप्ता भीमवेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वना। शक्तिरभ्यपतद्वेगाल्लक्ष्मणं रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Having said this, Rāvana waxing furiously enraged, discharged at Laksmana that dart forged by Maya with his power of illusion, furnished with eight bells, having might sounds,t Incapable of being resisted, competent to finish foes: and flaming in energy-and shouted simultaneously. And hurled with terrific force the dart sending sounds resembling that of Vajra of the thunder-bolt, vehemently alighted at Lakş maņa in that encounter.

sa: कैलासे मन्दरे मेरौ तथा चैत्ररथे वने॥ देवोद्यानेषु सर्वेषु विहृत्य सहिता त्वया। विमानेनानुरूपेण या याम्यतुलया श्रिया॥ पश्यन्ती विविधान्देशांस्तांस्तांश्चित्रनगम्बरा। भ्रंशिता कामभोगेभ्यः सास्मि वीर वधात्तव ॥
en: Roaming at large with you in a car unequalled in beauty on the hill Kailāsa Mandara, Meru, in the garden of Caitraratha and all other celestial gardens, beholding many a country, wearing variegated clothes and garlands, I have been deprived of all pleasures and enjoyments, O hero, by your death.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अपि मे जननी चेयं शुश्रूषुर्विगतक्लमा। अथास्याः सफलो राजन् वनवासो भविष्यति॥
en: Yudhishthira said Does your peace, O king, your self-control, your tranquility of heart, grow? Is this my mother able to serve you without fatigue and trouble.

sa: हताश्चात् तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः। खङ्गं चर्म तथा गृह्य सत्वं ब्राह्मणं ययौ॥
en: Then jumping down from the car, the heroes of which were slain, the mighty carwarrior speedily took up his sword and armour and approached the Brahmana.

sa: पृथ्वी उवाच ऋषयः पितरो देवा मनुष्याश्चैव माधव। इज्याश्चैवार्चनीयाश्च यथा चैव निबोध मे॥
en: The Goddess Earth said O Madhava, the Rishis, the celestials the departed Manes, and men should be adored, and sacrifices should be performed by a householder.

sa: गत्वाहं जामदग्न्यं तु प्रयाचिष्ये कुरूद्वह। भीष्मेण सह मा योत्सी: शिष्येणेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: O supporter of the Kuru race, going to the son of Jamadagni I shall beg of him again and again saying: Do not fight with Bhishma.

sa: तं मामेवंगतं मत्वा प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि। शंस मे भगवन् रामः क्व सम्प्रति महीपतिः॥
en: Thinking me as already gone, you should show your favour to me. O reverend Sir, tell me where stay at present Rāma, lord of the earth.

sa: तेनैवमुक्तो जनमेजयस्तं प्रत्युवाच-'भगवंस्तत् तथा भविष्यति ॥
en: Janamejaya thus addressed by the Rishi, said "It shall be as you say.

sa: निर्जितोऽस्मीति वा ब्रूयात् कुर्याद् वा वचनं तव। कृतमस्या भवेत् कार्यं कन्याया भृगुनन्दन॥
en: Either says “I am vanquished" or acts !p to your words then the object of this lady will be fulfilled, O delighter of the Bhrigu race.

sa: कामं बह्वपि वक्तव्यं त्वयि वक्ष्यामि न त्वहम्। अस्तं प्राप्नोति सविता युद्धविघ्नस्ततो भवेत्॥
en: But I will not parley much with you as much as I could wish: the sun is going to set, and our fight shall be interrupted.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच व्यानश्च तमुदानश्च भाषमाणमथोचतुः। अपान न त्वं श्रेष्ठोऽसि प्राणो हि वशगस्तव॥
en: The Brahmana said To Apana who said so, both Vyana and Udana said, O Apana, you are not the foremost (Only) Prana is under your dominion.

sa: सत्यमेतद्रघुश्रेष्ठ यद्ब्रवीषि हनूमति। न बले विद्यते तुल्यो न गतौ न मतौ परः॥
en: O foremost of Raghus, what, you have said regarding Hanumān, is all true. As regards, strength, velocity and intellect there is none who can equal Hanuman.

sa: धिमृत्युं च दुरात्मानं क्रूरं दुःखकरं सताम्। त्वां चैवाहं वधिष्यामि पापं पापस्य कारणम्॥
en: Accursed be the wicked and vengeful Death that causes misery to the good! I shall also kill you who are sinful and engaged in sinful deeds.

sa: स मद्रराजः सहसा विकीर्णो भीमाग्रगैः पाण्डवयोधमुख्यैः। युधिष्ठिरस्याभिमुखं जवेन सिंहो यथा मृगहेतोः प्रयातः॥
en: Assailed by those foremost of Pandava warriors headed by Bhimasena, the king of the Madras proceeded towards Yudhishthira, like a lion going to catch a deer.

sa: अरण्ये विजने न्यस्तं परस्वं दृश्यते यदा। मनसापि न हिंसन्ति ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who do not seek, even mentally, to take other peoples things even when they lie in a lone forest, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: ततो वितथमर्यादं तं दृष्ट्वा मुनिसत्तमाः। क्रुद्धा मोहाभिभूतास्ते सर्वे तत्राश्रमौकसः॥ अहोऽयं भिन्नमर्यादो नाश्रमे वस्तुमर्हति। तस्मादेनं वयं सर्वे पापात्मानं त्यजामहे॥
en: The excellent Rishis, the dwellers of the same hermitage, became indignant to see him transgress all propriety. They said, “This man transgresses all propriety. He deserves not to live in the hermitage. We shall all renounce this sinful wretch."

sa: रामाद् विशिष्टः कोऽन्योऽस्ति कश्चित् सौमित्रिणा समः। अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ।५३ ।।
en: Who is greater than Rāma? And who is equal to Saumitri? (i.e. Sumitra's son, Laksmana) And these brothers resembling Fire and the Wind, are your help.

sa: तथैव फाल्गुनेनापि यदुक्तं तत् त्वया श्रुतम्। आत्मनश्च मतं वीरं कथितं भवता सकृत्॥
en: In the same way what has been said by Falguna has been heard by you; and your own opinions, O hero have been expressed by you.

sa: तदलं ते वनं गत्वा क्षेमं नहि वनं तव। विमृशनिव पश्यामि बहुदोषकरं वनम्॥
en: You should not therefore go to the forest, it forebodes no good to you. Weighing well, have I concluded that the forest abounds in innumerable evils.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच स्मरन्ति वैरं रक्षांसि मायामाश्रित्य मोहिनीम्। हिडिम्बे व्रज पन्थानं त्वमिमं भ्रातृसेवितम्॥
en: Bhima said: woman even The Rakshasas revenge themselves on their enemy by alluring deceptions. Therefore, O Hidimba, go to the way that your brother has gone.

sa: पुरा द्वैतवने चासि मया पुत्र परीक्षितः। पानीयार्थे पराक्रान्ता यत्र ने भ्रातरो हताः॥
en: Formerly, O son, you were once examined by me in the forest of Dvaita, where your brothers of great prowess met with (an appearance of) death,

sa: संजय उवाच एवमस्त्विति मद्रेश उक्त्वा नोत्तरमुक्तवान्। याहि शल्येति चाप्येनं कर्णः प्राह युयुत्सया॥ स रथः प्रययौ शत्रूश्वेताश्वः शल्यसारथिः। निघ्नन्नमित्रान् समरे तमो घ्नन् सविता यथा॥
en: Sanjaya said The king of Madra said-'let it be so,' and gave no reply, when Karna desirous of fighting, said to Shalya 'go'. Then that carwarrior, having white horses and Shalya as his driver, dashed against his enemies killing a number of enemies in battle like the sun destroying darkness.

sa: चकार भैरवं नादं सर्वभूतभवंकरम्॥ छित्त्वा शिरो वै यज्ञस्य ननाद च मुमोद च।
en: They sent up loud roars which filled every living creature with fear. Having torn off the head of Sacrifice they began to cry aloud in joy.

sa: स तु श्रुत्वा महातेजा यदूनां निधनं प्रभो॥ आगन्ता क्षिप्रमेवेह न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा।
en: I have no doubt that as soon as he will hear of the destruction of the Yadus, that hero of mighty energy will come here forthwith.

sa: नारद उवाच एवमुक्तः सुपर्णेन तथ्यं वचनमुत्तमम्। विमृश्यावहितो राजा निश्चित्य च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Narada said Being thus addressed by Suparna in excellent words conducive to his benefit and think calmly on these words and considering them again and again,

sa: आयसं हृदयं कृत्वा मृगयस्व पुनः स्वकम्। परं विषहते यस्मात् तस्मात् पुरुष उच्यते॥
en: Making your heart one of steel, hunt for the recovery of your lost wealth; one is called a man (Purusha) for he vanquishes the enemy (Param).

sa: उद्भावय कुलं मग्नं त्वत्कृते स्वयमेव हि। यस्य वृत्तं न जल्पन्ति मानवा महदद्भुतम्॥
en: Raise up the race that has been sunk in infamy by your own doings. The man, whose great and wonderful feats men do not talk about.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ग्रहाः सोपग्रहाश्चैव ऋषयो मातरस्तथा। हुताशनमुखाश्चैव दृप्ताः पारिषदां गणाः॥ एते चान्ये च बहवो घोरास्त्रिदिववासिनः। परिवार्य महासेनं स्थिता मातृगणैः सह॥ संदिग्धं विजयं दृष्ट्वा विजयेप्सुः सुरेश्वरः। आरुखैरावतस्कन्धं प्रययौ दैवतैः सह॥
en: Markandeya said: The planets with their satellites, the Rishis and the mothers, Agni and numerrous other blazing countries and many other fearful dwellers of heaven waited on Mahasena with the mothers. The illustrious lord of the celestial, wishing to win victory and believing success to be difficult to be attained mounted his elephant. Airavata; and attended by the other celestial advanced towards Skanda.

sa: मया पाशुपतं दक्ष शुभमुत्पादितं पुरा। तस्य चीर्णस्य तत् सम्यक् फलं भवति पुष्कलम्।
en: In days of yore, O Daksha, this auspicious religion called Pashupata had been found out by me. The proper observance of that religion produces great benefits.

sa: ह्रदाश्च तव तीर्थत्वं गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः। ह्रदेषु तेषु यः स्नात्वा पितृन् संतर्पयिष्यति॥ पितरस्तस्य वै प्रीता दास्यन्ति भुवि दुर्लभम्। ईप्सितं च मन:कामं स्वर्गलोकं च शाश्वतम्॥
en: Without the least doubt your these lakes w. be Tirthas, he who will bathe in these lakes and offer oblations to the Pitris. Will make his Pitris pleased with him. They will grant him the desired objects so difficult to be obtained in this world and lead him to the celestials region."

sa: मत्प्रसादात् समुद्रं स तरिष्यति बलैः सह। मयैवेह च राक्षस्यो मायाय मोहिताः शुभे॥
en: Through my grace, he shall along with his forces cross over the ocean. And, O excellent wench, I have by my supernal power, stupified the Raksasis.

sa: तथैव सर्वसम्भारं स्वमंशं वितरामि ते। तथैव च मम प्रतिस्त्वयि वीर न संशयः॥
en: As before, I give you your portion of the whole kingdom. O hero, the amount of my love for you is doubtlessly the same as before.

sa: न भेतव्यं न गन्तव्यं निवर्तध्वं रणे सुराः। एष गच्छति पुत्रो मे युद्धार्थमपराजितः॥
en: Be not afraid, O you celestials; do not fly away; come back to the battle; this my son, who has never been vanquished, goes to battle.

sa: मानितास्ते तु विप्रेन्द्रास्त्वं तु गच्छ द्विजोत्तम॥
en: The Brahmanas have been sufficiently honoured. Do you go to that king now.

sa: सोऽहं परापराधेम विनशेयं निशाचर। कुरु यत् ते क्षमं तत्त्वमहं त्वां नानुयामि वै॥
en: And I shall meet with a similar fate for your sins. O you the ranger of night do whatever you like, I shall not follow you.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच भगवश्वशुरो मेऽसि दैवतस्यापि दैवतम्। स मे देवातिदेवस्त्वं शृणु सत्या गिरं मम॥
en: Kunti said O holy one, you are my father-in-law and, therefore, my deity of deities. You are my god of gods. Hear my words of truth.

sa: फले क्षीणे महाराज फलं पुण्यमवाप्स्यसि। ततो मे विस्मयो जातस्तद् दृष्ट्वा तपसो बलम्॥
en: Will come to an end, you will enjoy the fruits of your virtue." I was then lost in wonder on beholding the strength of his asceticism.

sa: रुद्रं जग्मुः भग्नाश्चापि सुरा आसन भीताश्चाद्यापि तं प्रति॥ असुराणां पुराण्यासंस्रीणि वीर्यवतां दिवि।
en: The gods that had fled away returned. Indeed they are afraid of Maheshvara even to this day. Formerly the puissant Asuras had three cities in heaven.

sa: रहस्येकां तु तां दृष्ट्वा राजा राजीवलोचनाम्। न शशाक नियन्तुं तं कामं कामवशीकृतः॥
en: The king could not suppress his desire on seeing his lotus eyed wife and he was completely overcome by it in that solitude of the wood.

sa: तवाच ततः सूतो राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति। श्रुत्वा प्रमाणं तत्र त्वं गमनायेतराय वा॥
en: Thereupon, the charioteer told him, "The sovereign wish to behold you. You have known the occasion; and now decide whether you will go thither or not.”

sa: जनमेजयस्य भ्रातृभिरभिहतो भ्रातृभिरभिहतो रोरूयमाणो मातुः समीपमुपागच्छत्॥
en: He, being beaten by the brothers of Janamejaya, went to his mother weeping.

sa: तं प्रहस्याब्रवीद् देव ऋषि रागेण मोहितम्॥
en: To that Rishi who was blinded by emotion, the deity smilingly thus spoke,

sa: यो विकर्मस्थितो विप्रो न स सम्मानमर्हति। कर्म स्वं नोपयुञ्जानमविश्वास्यं हि तं विदुः॥
en: That Brahmana who does works that are not sanctioned for him, deserves no respect. If not engaged in his proper acts, he should not be trusted.

sa: इमां च तावद् धर्मात्मन् पौराणीं शृणु मे कथाम्। परिश्रुतां विशालाक्ष कीर्तयिष्यामि यामहम्॥
en: O virtuous minded man, O large eyed one, hear the (following) Pauranika narrative which was heard by me and which I shall now narrate to you.

sa: अजेया ब्राह्मणा राजन् दिवि चेह च नित्यदा। अपिबत् तेजसा ह्यापः स्वयमेवाङ्गिराः पुरा॥
en: The Brahmanas are always unconquerable, O king, in Heaven as also on Earth. Formerly, the great Rishi Angirasa, through his energy, drank off all the water.

sa: बाहूनिवैतान् मा छेत्सीः पाण्डुपुत्रास्तथैव ते। भ्रातृणां तद्धनार्थं वै मित्रद्रोहं च मा कुरु॥
en: The Pandavas are like your arms; do not chop off your those arms. do not plunge yourself into internal dissensions coveting the wealth of your brothers.

sa: किंदाने च नरः स्नात्वा किंजप्ये च महीपते। अप्रमेयमवाणोति दानं जप्यं च भारत॥
en: O ruler of earth, O descendant of Bharata, bathing in Kindana and Kinjapya, one obtains the fruits of measureless gifts and of infinite recitation of prayers.

sa: तौ चैवानय भद्रं ते पानीयं च त्वमानय। त्वं हि नस्तात सर्वेषां दुःखितानामपाश्रयः॥
en: May you be in peace. Go and bring them and also water. O affectionate one, you are the refuge of all of us when in distress."

sa: मारीचस्य तु मायैषा पूर्वोक्तं लक्ष्मणेन तु। तत् तथा ह्यभवच्चाद्य मारीचोऽयं मया हतः॥
en: While returning he thought Mārīca aside Lakş mana said before that this was Mārica's illusion! His words have been verified now. Truly have I killed Mārīca.

sa: मन्युर्न च त्वया कार्यो देवि ब्रूमि तवाग्रतः। यास्यामि भव सुप्रीता वनं चीरजटाधरः॥
en: be not angry, Oh worshipful one, I speak before you, be you propitiated well, and I shall go to the forest wearing bark and matted hair.

sa: य एते राक्षसाः प्रोक्ता घोररूपा महाबलाः। राघवे निर्विषाः सर्वे सुपर्णे पन्नगा यथा॥
en: All the mighty Rākşasas of grim visages, whom you have extolled (before me), shall be deprived of their venom before Rāma, as serpents are before Suparna,

sa: नाहं जीवति गाङ्गेये योत्स्ये राजन् कथंचन। हते भीष्मे तु योद्धास्मि सर्वैरेव महारथैः॥
en: O king, never shall I fight as long as the son of Ganga is alive. When Bhishma is killed I shall fight with all the car-warriors."

sa: पुनरेव ततो दूराद् वृक्षखण्डाद् विनिःसृतः। दृष्ट्वा रामो महातेजास्तं हन्तुं कृतनिश्चयः॥ भूयस्तु शरमुद्धत्य कुपितस्तत्र राघवः। सूर्यरश्मिप्रतीकाशं ज्वलन्तमरिमर्दनम् ॥ संधाय सुदृढे चापे विकृष्य बलवदबली। तमेव मृगमुद्दिश्य श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम्॥ मुमोच ज्वलितं दीप्तमस्त्रं ब्रह्मविनिर्मितम्।
en: And again showed himself at a distance behind a tree. And seeing him, the exceedingly energetic and strong Rāghava, determined to slay him, growing wroth, taking out a flaming shaft, resembling the rays of the sun, powerfully drew his bow, and firmly setting the shaft, and aiming it at the deer, let go the blazing and burning weapon forged by Brahmā, resembling a flaiming serpent.

sa: यत् तत्र भवतः किंचिच्छक्यं कर्तुं प्रियं मया। प्राणानपि परित्यज्य सर्वथा कृतमेव तत्॥
en: If I can, even at the sacrifice of my own life, satisfy my worshipful father, rest assured it is to be done first in all manner.

sa: तदज्ञानकृतं मत्वा ब्राह्मणाय न्यवेदयत्। कर्णः प्रसादयंश्चैनमिदमित्यब्रवीद् वचः॥ अबुद्धिपूर्वं भगवन् धेनुरेषा हता तव। मया तत्र प्रसादं च कुरुष्वेति पुनः पुनः॥ तं स विप्रोऽब्रवीत्क्रुद्धो वाचा निर्भर्त्सयन्निव। दुराचार वधार्हस्त्वं फलं प्रात्नुहि दुर्मते॥
en: Knowing that he had perpetrated that crime from carelessness, he informed the Brahmana of it. For pleasing the owner, Karna repeatedly said,-O Rishi, I have killed this your cow against my will. Forgive the act! Filled with anger the Brahmana, rebuking him, said, O wicked wight, you should be killed! May you suffer the fruit of this act, O you of wicked soul!

sa: तत्र स्नायुमयान् पाशान् यथावत् संविधाय सः। गृहं गत्वा सुखं शेते प्रभातामेति शर्वरीम्॥
en: Spreading his nets made a leathern strings, he returned to his hut, and, passing the night happily in sleep, returned thert at the dawn of day.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं वैश्यापुत्रेण भाषितम्। प्राप्तकालमिति श्रुत्वा विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित्॥ अपूजयदमेयात्मा युयुत्सुं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Hearing those words of the son of Dhritarashtra's Vaishya wife the great Vidura, conversant with practices and feelings for the hour, praised the eloquent Yuyutsu. come

sa: ये वा पापं न कुर्वन्ति कर्मणा मनसा गिरा। निक्षिप्तदण्डा भूतेषु दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who do not commit any kind of sin in thought, word, and deed, those, who never injure any creature, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: चोदयामास तद् वज्रं दिव्यास्त्रं मूर्तिमत् स्थितम्। व्याघ्रो भूत्वा जहीमं त्वं राजपुत्रमिति प्रभो॥
en: He commanded his celestial weapon Thunder, standing before him, in embodied from saying,-Go, O powerful one, and assuming the form of a tiger kill this prince.

sa: क्व ते कृतास्त्रता याता किञ्च शेषे जलाशये। स त्वमुत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्व क्षत्रधर्मेण भारत॥
en: Where is that your mastery in weapons? Why do you live within this lake now? Arise, O Bharata and fight, following the duties of a Kshatriya.

sa: सम्भूता यतो देवी पत्नी धर्मस्य धीमतः। श्रियः सकाशादर्थश्च जातो धर्मेण पाण्डव॥ श्री:
en: The Goddess Shree was born of that lotus. she became the consort of the highly intelligent Dharma. Upon Sree, O son of Pandu, Dharma begot Artha.

sa: पितॄन् पितामहान् भ्रातृन् गुरून् सम्बन्धिबान्धवान्। मिथ्याप्रवृत्तान् यः संख्ये निहन्याद् धर्म एव सः॥
en: Kshatriyas should kill fathers and grandfathers and brothers and preceptors and relatives and kinsmen that may give them an unjust battle. This is their open duty.

sa: अन्तर्जलात् समुत्तस्थौ नागेन्द्र इव नि:श्वसन्। स भित्त्वा स्तम्भितं तोयं स्कन्धे कृत्वाऽऽयसीं गदाम्॥
en: Cutting through the solidified waters your son rose carrying his mace made of iron at his shoulders, like the sun himself consuming everything with his rays.

sa: द्विजस्य क्षत्रबन्धोर्वा कस्येयं पृथिवी भवेत्। : सह वित्तेन सम्यग् वायो प्रचक्ष्व मे॥
en: Pururavas said Tell me, truly, O god of Wind, to whom does this Earth fairly belong, Does it belong to the Brahmana or to the Kshatriya.

sa: उलूकश्च महावीर्यः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥ समागम्याथ शनकैरश्वत्थामा महाबलः। तव पुत्राश्च कात्स्येन जुगुपुः शल्यमाहवे॥
en: The generally energetic Uluka, Shakuni, the son of Subala and the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman smiling and all your sons protected Shalya every way in that battle.

sa: एतद् धनमपर्यन्तमश्वमेधे महामखे। शशबिन्दुर्महाराज ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समार्पयत्॥
en: The immense wealth, O King, Sashavindu distributed in a Horse-sacrifice amongst the Brahmanas.

sa: अहं तं जीवयिष्यामि दग्धं शस्त्राग्नितेजसा। पश्य मे तपसो वीर्यं सत्यस्य च नराधम॥
en: Thought burnt by the energy of your weapon's fire, I shall revive him. O lowest of men, witness the power of my austerities and my truth.'

sa: व नु धर्मज्ञता राज्ञः क्व नु साद्यानृशंसता। यचावधीत् पितॄन् भ्रातॄन् गुरुपुत्रान् सखीनपि।॥
en: Where, indeed, in that righteousness of the king, where his truth and pity, since he has killed sires and brothers and preceptors and sons and friends.

sa: किं चाहमभिधास्यामि वाक्यं ते तव संनिधौ। यदा वाचोगतं सर्वं तव वाचि समाहितम्॥
en: But what words, O master of speech, can I communicate in your presence, when especially all the subjects of speech have been treated in your specch?

sa: तपो यज्ञादपि श्रेष्ठमित्येषा परमा श्रुतिः। तत् ते वपः प्रवक्ष्यामि विद्वंस्तदपि मे शृणु॥
en: There is an injunction in the Vedas that penances are higher than sacrifices. I shall now describe penances to you. O learned prince listen to me.

sa: अपृच्छत् क्षत्रियांस्तत्र क्व नु राजा महाबलः। शकुनेस्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा तमूचुर्भरतर्षभ।।३। असौ तिष्ठति कौरव्यो रणमध्ये महाबलः। यत्रैतत् सुमहच्छत्रं पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभम्॥ यत्र ते सतनुत्राणा रथास्तिष्ठन्ति दंशिताः। यत्रैष तुमुलः शब्दः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः॥ तत्र गच्छ द्रुतं राजंस्ततो द्रक्ष्यसि कौरवम्। एवमुक्तस्तु तैर्योधैः शकुनिः सौबलस्तदा॥ प्रययौ तत्र यत्रासौ पुत्रस्तव नराधिप। सर्वतः संवृत्तो वीरैः समरे चित्रयोधिभिः॥
en: And he asked the Kshatriyas assembled there, saying-"Where is the king that great carwarrior!"-Hearing those words of Shakuni, O foremost of Bharatas, they replied saying "There stands the great car-warrior, viz., the Kuru king-there the large umbrella, effulgent like the full moon, is seen, —there where those car-warriors, clad in mail, are staying-there where that loud noise, deep as the muttering of clouds, is being heard. Go quickly thither, O king and you will see the Kuru king."-Thus spoken to by those brave warriors. Subala's son Shakuni, O king, proceeded where your son was waiting, surrounded on all sides by unretreating heroes.

sa: क्रुद्धस्तु स समासाद्य तावृषी भ्रातरौ तदा॥ उवाच परुषं वाक्यं शशाप च महातपाः।
en: Meeting with those two Rishi, viz., his brothers, he became enraged with them. Endued with ascetic merit, he spoke harshly to them and cursed them, saying.

sa: कश्यप उवाच यथैकगेहे जातवेदाः प्रदीप्तः कृत्स्नं ग्रामं दहते चत्वरं वा। विमोहनं कुरुते देव एष ततः सर्वं स्पृश्यते पुण्यपापैः॥
en: Kashyapa said, Fire burning in one house, burns a whole quarter or an entire village. Likewise this deity stupefies the senses of some one and then that stupefaction affects all, the honest and the wicked alike, without any distinction.

sa: यदि किंचिन्मयाज्ञानात् पुरस्ताद् दुष्कृतं कृतम्। न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं क्षामये त्वां प्रसीद मे॥
en: If I have ever, before this, unknowingly done you any wrong, you should not bear it in mind. I beg your pardon. Be pleased with me.

sa: इदं तु श्रूयते पार्थ युद्धे देवासुरे पुरा। असुरा भ्रातरो ज्येष्ठा देवाश्चापि यवीयसः॥
en: It is heard, O Partha, that the gods and the Asuras fought against each other. The Asuras were the elder, and the gods the younger brothers.

sa: पानीयमपरे पीत्वा पर्याश्वास्य च वाहनम्॥ वर्माणि च समारोप्य केचिद् भरतसत्तम। समाश्वास्यापरे भ्रातॄन् निक्षिप्य शिबिरेऽपि च॥ पुत्रानन्ये पितॄनन्ये पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्।
en: Some, having satisfied their thirst or rested their animals and some wearing (flesh) armours, O chief of the Bharatas and some, having comforted their brothers and sons and father and placed them in camp, once more came to battle.

sa: निगृहीतादमात्याच्च स्त्रीभ्यश्चैव विशेषतः। पर्वताद् विषमाद् दुर्गाद्धस्तिनोऽश्वात् सरीसृपात्। एतेभ्यो नित्ययुक्तः सन् रक्षेदात्मानमेव तु॥ मुख्यानमात्यान् यो हित्वा निहीनान् कुरुते प्रियान्। स वै व्यसनमासाद्य गाधमार्तो न विन्दति॥
en: From ministers, who have once been chastised, from women in particular, from mountains and inaccessible quarrels, from elephants and horses and reptiles, the king should always carefully guard himself. That king, who, leaving his chief ministers, makes favourites of low persons, soon falls into distress and never succeeds in attaining his objects.

sa: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। पीडितान् पाण्डवान् दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजवशंगतान्॥ अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मद्राणामधिपं बलात्।
en: Riding then upon another car, the mighty and powerful Satyaki, seeing the Pandavas assailed and yielding to the king of the Madras, rushed quickly against him.

sa: सदेवगन्धर्वमनुष्यपूजितं निहत्य कर्ण रिपुमाहवेऽर्जुनः। रराज राजन् परमेण वर्चसा यथा पुरा वृत्रवधे शतक्रतुः॥
en: Having killed his enemy Karna, adored of the celestials, men and Gandharvas Arjuna shone in his energy like the thousand-eyed deity after the destruction of Vritra.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच युज्यतां मे रथवरः फाल्गुनाप्रतिमद्युते॥ न सैनिकैश्च यातव्यं यास्यामो वयमेव हि।
en: ‘O Phalguna of matchless splendour, let my best of cars be made ready. We should not be accompanied by the soldiers, but we shall proceed alone.

sa: न देवलगतिस्तत्र तव गन्तुं तपोधन। ब्रह्मणः सदने विप्र जैगीषव्यो यदाप्तवान्।॥ तद् वचनं
en: The Siddhas then, once more addressing Devala said to him-"You O Devala, are not competent to proceed to the region of Brahman, where Jaigishavya has gone!

sa: भवतोऽर्थकृदित्येवं मयि दोषो हि तैः कृतः। विद्यते कारणं नान्यदिति मे नात्र संशयः॥
en: They have found fault with me, because I seek your well-being. I have no doubt that there is no other cause for their hostility to me.

sa: तस्य मे रोचते राजन् क्षुधितस्येव भोजनम्। अमात्या मे न रोचन्ते वितृष्णस्य यथोदकम्॥
en: Like food to a hungry person, you have become dear to me. dislike your ministers, however, as a person, whose thirst has been satisfied, dislikes drink.

sa: संजय उवाच आगम्य नानादेशेभ्यो नानाजनपदेश्वराः। पितृलोकं गता राजन् सर्वे तव सुतैः सह॥
en: Sanjaya said The kings of various races, that came from various kingdoms, have all, O king, gone to the abode of Death along with your sons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उषित्वा तत्र रामस्तु सम्पूज्याश्रमवासिनः। तथा मङ्कणके प्रीतिं शुभां चक्रे हलायुधः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having passed one night there, Rama, having the plough for his weapon, adored the dwellers of that tirtha and showed great respect for Mankanaka.

sa: यत्र सा बदरी रम्या ह्रदो वैहायसस्तथा। यत्र चाश्वशिरा राजन् वेदान् पठति शाश्वतान्॥
en: There lies the charming spot called Badari, and there also is that lake in the sky. There the sage Ashvashiras, O king, reads the eternal Vedas.

sa: विश्वासाद्धिं पर राजन् राज्ञामुत्पद्यते भयम्। कथं हि नाश्वसन् राजा शत्रून् जयति पार्थिवः॥
en: O king, you have said, great danger arises to kings from confidence. But how, ) monarch, can a king, without trust on others, conquers his enemies.

sa: अल्पं च बलमेतेषां कृष्णौ च भृशविक्षतौ॥ अद्य सर्वान् हनिष्यामि ध्रुवोहि विजयो भवेत्।
en: The Pandava army is very small now. The two Krishnas have been assailed with wounds. If we all stand for battle we will surely win victory.

sa: ततः कृष्णः पार्थमुवाच संख्ये महोरगं कृतवैरं जहि त्वम्॥ स एवमुक्तो मधुसदनेन गाण्डीवधन्वा रिपुवीर्यसाहः। उवाच को ह्येष ममाद्य नागः स्वयं य आयाद् गरुडस्य वक्त्रम्॥
en: Thereupon Krishna said to Partha in the battle-field “kill the great snake whom you have made an enemy.” Thus spoken to by the slayer of Madhu, the holder of Gandiva bow, ever holding this Naga who, of his own accord, comes against me as if into the mouth of Garuda.

sa: ये च वीतभया नित्यं हरस्य भृकुटीसहाः।
en: They know not fear, and are capable of enduring the frowns of Hara.

sa: ततो वसति दुष्कर्मा नरके शाश्वतीः समाः। प्रजानां कल्मषे मग्नोऽकीर्तिं पापं च विन्दति॥
en: Sullied by wickedness, he suffers in hell for numberless years, for being drowned in the sins of his subjects, he incurs great sin and infamy himself.

sa: न हि ते राजशार्दूल बले तुल्योऽस्ति कश्चन। कः सहेत महाबाहो बाह्वेर्विग्रहणं नरः॥
en: O best of kings, there is none equal to you in physical strength. Who is there, O mightyarmed one, that would bear pressure of your arms.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ऋषिरासीन्महावीर्यः कुणिर्गो महायशाः। स तप्त्वा विपुलं राजस्तपो वै तपतां वरः॥ मनसाऽथ सुतां सुभुं समुत्पादितवान् विभुः। तां च दृष्ट्वा मुनिः प्रीतः कुणिर्गों महायशाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said "There a highly illustrious and energetic Rishi, named Kuni-Garga. Having practised the austerest of penances, O king, that best of ascetics, created a fair browed daughter by his desire. Secing her, the celebrated ascetic Kuni-Garga was filled with joy. He renounced his body, O king and then went to heaven.

sa: मुनिरुवाच न भयं द्वीपीनः कार्यं मृत्युतस्ते कथंचन। एष श्वरूपरहितो द्वीपी भवसि पुत्रक॥
en: The sage said You shall have no fear of death from leopards any longer! Let your natural from disappear and be you a leopard, O son!

sa: हत्वा तव बलं सर्वं संग्रामे धृतराष्ट्रजः। जितान् पाण्डुसुतान् मत्वा रूपं धारयते महत्॥
en: Having killed a large number your soldiers in battle the son of Dhritarashtra looks highly delighted as if he believes that the Pandavas have been defeated.

sa: एवं विचिनुयाद् राजा परचारं विचक्षणः। चारे हि विदिते पूर्वं हितं भवति पाण्डव॥
en: An intelligent king may thus ascertain the spies sent by his enemies. If these be known, the king may derive iinmense benefit, O son of Pandu.

sa: यत्र यत्र हतः शूरः शत्रुभिः परिवारितः। अक्षयाँल्लभते लोकान् यदि दैन्यं न सेवते॥
en: Wherever the hero has met with death in the inidst of enemies without showing ignoble fear or cheerlessness, he has succeeded in acquiring blessed regions hereafter.

sa: ये क्रोधं संनियच्छन्ति क्रुद्धान् संशमयन्ति च। न च कुप्यन्ति भूतानां दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who conquer their own anger and pacify the anger of others, and who are never irate with any one, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: कृतज्ञो दृढभक्तिः स्यात् संविभागी जितेन्द्रियः। ईक्षितः प्रतिवीक्षेत मृदु वल्गु च सुष्ठु च॥
en: Grateful, firmly devoted, and with subdued passions, he should give to others their due. Eyed by others, he should look at them mildly, sweetly, and beautifully.

sa: एतावानिह संवासो विहितस्ते मया सह। षण्मासान् सप्तमे मासि त्वं वीर निधनं गतः॥
en: Your union with me in this world had, it seems, been ordained for only six months, for on the seventh, O hero, you lost your life.

sa: पुमान् यज्ञश्च सोमश्च न्यायवृत्तो यदा भवेत्। अन्यायवृत्तः पुरुषो न परस्य न चात्मनः॥
en: These three, viz., a person, a sacrifice, and Soma, must have good character. A person of a bad character neither enjoy this nor the other world.

sa: किं ते धनैर्बान्धवैर्वापि किं ते कि ते दारैर्ब्राह्मण यो मरिष्यसि। आत्मानमन्विच्छ गुहां प्रविष्टं पितामहास्ते क्व गताः पिता च॥
en: Why do you require riches, relatives, friends, and wives? You are a Brahmana and you have death to encounter! Search you own Self which is concealed in a cave. Where have your grandfathers gone and where your father too?

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच श्रूयतां पृथिवीपाल क्षरतीदं यथा जगत्। यन्न क्षरति पूर्वेण यावत्कालेन वाप्यथ॥
en: Hear, O king, as to how this universe is destroyed, and of That which was never destroyed and which will never be destroyed at any time.

sa: स हि सद्भावितो राजा मद्भक्तश्च भविष्यति। तेन शास्त्रेण लोकेषु क्रियाः सर्वाः करिष्यति॥
en: Filled with all good thoughts, that king will become deeply devoted to me. Guided by this work, he will perform all his religious deeds and observance.

sa: सत्त्वेनानुप्रवेशो हि योऽयं त्वयि कृतो मया। किं तवापकृतं यत्र यदि मुक्तोऽसि सर्वशः॥
en: If be true that you have been freed from all fetters, what harm then have I done you by entering your body with only my Intellect?

sa: किं ते धनेन किं बन्धुभिस्ते किं ते पुत्रैः पुत्रक यो मरिष्यसि। आत्मानमन्विच्छ गुहां प्रविष्टं पितामहास्ते क्व गताश्च सर्वे॥
en: What use have you of riches, O son, or of relatives, or of children, since you have to die? Do you engage in seeking for your soul which is hidden in a cave. Where have all your grandfathers gone?

sa: तस्मात् तीक्ष्णः प्रजा राजा स्वधर्मे स्थापयेत् ततः। अन्योन्यं भक्षयन्तो हि प्रचरेयुर्वृका इव॥
en: Therefore, a king should force all his subjects to observe their respective duties. If this is not done, they will prowl like wolves, devouring one another,

sa: न हहानि निवर्तन्ते न मासा न पुनः क्षपाः। सोऽहं प्रपद्यतेऽध्वानं चिराय ध्रुवमध्रुवः॥
en: Neither days, nor nights, nor months, cease to go on. Only that man who, though transitory, follows the eternal path succeeds in avoiding birth and death.

sa: धर्मो राजन् गुणः श्रेष्ठो मध्यमो ह्यर्थ उच्यते। कामो यवीयानिति च प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: Virtue, O king, is foremost of all. Profit is said to be middling. Desire it is said by the wise, is the lowest of the three.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तिष्ठते मे सदा तात कौतूहलमिदं हृदि। तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्तः कुरुपितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said This curiosity, O sire, is always living in my mind. O grandfather to the Kurus, I wish to hear everything about it form you!

sa: एतत् ते कथितं तात यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। पापं धर्मस्तथा मोक्षो निर्वेदश्चैव भारत॥
en: I have now told you, O Son, of that about which you had asked me, viz., the topics of Sin, Righteousness, Renunciation, and Liberation, O Bharata.

sa: कृतानि यानि कर्माणि दैवतैर्मुनिभिस्तथा। न चरेत् तानि धर्मात्मा श्रुत्वा चापि न कुत्सयेत्॥
en: As to those acts of the gods or repeated ascctics, a pious man should never do their like or, informed to them, should never censure them.

sa: शिष्या ऊचुः महता तेजसा युक्ता यशसा चापि वर्धिताः। एकं त्विदानीमिच्छामो गुरुणानुग्रहं कृतम्॥
en: We have, through your favour, been ended with great energy. Our fame, also has spread. There is one favour that we pray you to grant us.

sa: जिह्वामध्यात्ममित्याहुर्यथा श्रुतिनिदर्शिनः। रस एवाधिभूतं तु आपस्तत्राधिदैवतम्॥
en: The tongue is Spiritual; taste is its Elemental; and Water is its Accidental.

sa: सृजतेऽत्र गुणानेक एको न सृजते गुणान्। पृथग्भूतौ प्रकृत्या तौ सम्प्रयुक्तौ च सर्वदा॥
en: One of them creates the qualities. The other does not create them. Though they are different from each other by nature, they are, however, always united.

sa: तौ सखायौ पुरा ह्यास्तां मानुषत्वे परंतप। अन्यां योनि समापन्नौ शार्गाली वानरी तथा॥
en: While both were human beings, O scorcher of enemies, they were intimate friends. After death one of them became a jackal and the other an ape.

sa: एतद् रहस्यं परमं ब्रह्मणो हृदि संस्थितम्। ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच शक्राय शक्रः प्रोवाच मृत्यवे॥
en: This hymn is a great mystery. It formerly lived in the breast of Brahinan the Creator. Branman gave it to Shakra. Shakra gave it to Death.

sa: कष्टः क्षत्रियधर्मोऽयं सौहृदं त्वयि मे स्थितम्। उग्रकर्मणि सृष्टोऽसि तस्माद् राज्यं प्रशाधि वै॥
en: The observance of Kshatriya duties is highly difficult. I love you greatly. You are created for the performance of severe acts. Therefore, do you rule kingdom.

sa: सौतिरुवाच जनमेजयेन यत् पृष्टः शिष्यो व्यासस्य धीमतः। तत् तेऽहं कथयिष्यामि पौराणं शौनकोत्तम॥
en: O excellent Saunaka, I shall recount to you what Vaishampayana, the disciple of the intelligent Vyasa, said when questioned on these very topics by king Janamejaya.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। जैगीषव्यस्य संवादमसितस्य च भारत॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Jaigishavya and Asita, O Bharata.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमा गाथाः सत्यवता कृताः। यथा कुमारः सत्यो वै नैव पुण्यो न पापकृत्॥
en: Regarding it is cited the following verse composed by Satyavat (One should act) as a child full of simplicity and shorn of either merit or sin.

sa: यथान्धः स्वगृहे युक्तो ह्यभ्यासादेव गच्छति। तथा युक्तेन मनसा प्राज्ञो गच्छति तां गतिम्॥
en: Like a blind man who, with attention, can move about his own house, the wise man, with mind fixed on Yoga, can proceed along the road.

sa: इन्द्रं दृष्ट्वा तु राजर्षिः पादयोः शिरसा गतः। प्रसीद त्रिदशश्रेष्ठ पुत्रकामेन स क्रतुः॥
en: You should, therefore, pardon me. Seeing the transformed king prostrate himself thus to him, Indra became pleased with him and wished to give him a boon.

sa: मांसादी सदा च स्यात् पवित्रश्च सदा भवेत्। अमृताशी सदा च स्याद् देवतातिथिपूजकः॥
en: He will become a vegetarian always, and pure for ever. He will become an eater always of ambrosia, and an worshipper always of gods and guests.

sa: नान्तः शक्यो गुणानां च वक्तुं सत्यस्य पार्थिव। अतः सत्यं प्रशंसन्ति विप्राः सपितृदेवताः॥
en: It is impossible, o king, to exhaust the merits of Truth. For these reasons the Brahman as, the Pitris and the gods speak highly of truth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अयं स भगवान् देवः पितामह जनार्दनः। सनत्कुमारो वृत्राय यत्तदाख्यातवान् पुरा॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, whether this Janardana (Krishna) is that illustrious and powerful Lord of whom Sanatkumara spoke to Vritra in days of yore.

sa: लोकत्रयस्य कृत्स्नस्य कथं कार्यः परिग्रहः। कथं बलक्षयो न स्याद् युष्माकं ह्यात्मनश्च मे॥
en: How should the three words be maintained and kept agoing? How should your strength and mine be taken advantage of for the accomplishment of that object.

sa: तुष्टः पितामहस्तेऽद्य तथा देवाः सवासवाः। स त्वं येन च कार्येण सम्प्राप्तो भगवानिह॥
en: The grandfather himself and all the gods with Indra have been pleased with you. I know the object for which your illustrious self has come here.

sa: बालो युवा वा वृद्धश्च यत् करोति शुभाशुभम्। तस्यां तस्यामवस्थायां भुङ्क्ते जन्मनि जन्मनि॥
en: Whatever acts good and bad one does in childhood, youth, or old age, one enjoys and suffer their consequences in his next life in similar ages.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स कौन्तेय वृत्रः प्राणान वासृजत्। योजयित्वा तथाऽऽत्मानं परं स्थानमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Bhishma continued Having said these words, O son of Kunti, Vritra renounced his life-breaths, uniting his soul (with the Supreme Soul), and attained to highest station.

sa: येन येन यथा यद् यत्पुरा कर्म सुनिश्चितम्। तत् तदेकतरो भुङ्क्ते नित्यं विहितमात्मना॥
en: Whatever the acts one does by whatever means and under whatever circumstances, are sure to be enjoyed and suffered by the doer in his next life.

sa: ये तु शक्रकथां दिव्यामिमां पर्वसु पर्वसु। विप्रमध्ये वदिष्यन्ति न ते प्राप्स्यन्ति किल्बिषम्॥
en: Those men who, on every Parva day, will recite this sacred narrative of Vritra in the midst of Brahmanas shall never be sullied by any sin.

sa: दृष्टं हि सहदेवेन दिशं विजयता तदा। ततस्तां समलंकृत्य कन्यामाहृतवाससम्॥ ददौ दुर्योधनो राजा पावकाय महात्मने। प्रतिजग्राह चाग्निस्तु राजकन्यां सुदर्शनाम्॥ विधिना वेददृष्टेन वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे। तस्या रूपेण शीलेन कुलेन वपुषा श्रिया॥ अभवत् प्रीतिमानग्निर्गर्भे चास्या मनो दधे। तस्याः समभवत्पुत्रो नाम्नाऽऽग्नेयः सुदर्शनः॥
en: Then the king gave his daughter, dressed in new raiments and decked with jewels, to the great god, and Agni too accepted, according to Vedic rites, the princess Sudarshana as his bride, as he accepts libations of clarified butter at sacrifices. Agni was well pleased with her look, her beauty, grace, character, and nobility of birth, and thought of begetting offspring upon her. And she soon gave birth to a son by Agni, of the name of Sudarshana.

sa: प्राणा हि मम दाराश्च यच्चानद् विद्यते वसु। अतिथिभ्यो मया देयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: My life, my wife and all my earthly belongings, are all dedicated to the use of my guests! This is the vow that I have taken.

sa: येन कार्येण सम्प्राप्तौ युवां तत् साधयामि किम्। वियतामात्मनः श्रेयस्तत् सर्वे प्रददानि वाम्॥
en: What business of yours has brought you here? I will perform it. Ask for the boon that will benefit you? I will grant all your desire.

sa: किं नु श्रेयस्करं कर्म भवेदद्येति चिन्तयन्। इह वा विनिवर्तेयं गच्छेयं वा युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: He began to reflect-‘Which of these two acts will now be beneficial for me viz., to turn back to the Samshaptakas or to repair to Yudhishthira.'

sa: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्ग जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्। तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: If killed, you will attain to heaven; and if victorious, you will enjoy the whole world. Therefore, being resolved to fight, arise, O son of Kunti.

sa: संजय उवाच एवं सकथयन्तौ तौ प्रविष्टौ शिबिरं स्वकम्। ददृशाते भृशास्वस्थान् पाण्डवान् नष्टचेतसः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus talking to one another, they both entered into their encampments and they beheld the Pandavas sit cheerless and with hearts distracted (with grief).

sa: शक्तीश्च विमलास्तीक्ष्णा गदाश्च परिघैः सह। प्रासान् परश्वघांश्चैव मुद्गरान् मुसलानपि॥ चिक्षिपुः समरे क्रुद्धाः फाल्गुनस्य रथं प्रति। शस्त्राणामथ तां वृष्टिं शलभानामिवायतिम्॥ रुरोध सर्वतः पार्थः शरैः कनकभूषणैः। तत्र तल्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा बीभत्सोरतिमानुषम्॥ देवदानवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः। साधु साध्विति राजेन्द्र फाल्गुनं प्रत्यपूजयन्॥
en: They angrily hurled at Falguna's (Arjuna's) car bright and sharp pointed lances, maces, clubs with spikes, bearded darts, battle-axes, mallets, and bludgeons. That. shower of weapons came to him like a flight of locusts. But Pritha's son checked it with his gold decked arrows. Seeing on that occasion the extraordinary lightness of the hands of Vibhatsu (Arjuna), the celestials, in the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas the Uragas and the Rakshasas praised Phalguna, exclaiming “Excellent” “Excellent”.

sa: अन्वश्वं दश धानुष्का धानुष्के दश चर्मिणः। एवं व्यूढं महाराज तव सैन्यं महारथैः॥
en: Behind every horsemen were stationed ten bowmen, and behind each bowman were placed seven foot-soldiers. Thus, O monarch, your troops urged by mighty and great carwarriors.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा त्वरन् द्रोणः स्पृष्ट्वाम्भो वर्म भास्वरम्। आबबन्धाद्भुततमं जपन् मन्त्रं यथाविधि॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, Drona quickly rinced his mouth with water and then bound that lustrous armour on Duryodhana, having duly reiterated most marvellous incantations.

sa: कृप उवाच यदि मां नाभिगच्छेथा युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय सर्वशः॥
en: Kripa said "If having resolved to fight, you failed to have come to me, I would have cursed you, O king, for bringing about your defeat.

sa: तौ कदाचिद् गृहं तस्य प्रविष्टौ तद्दिक्षया। विधिवच्चार्चितौ तेन प्रीतौ तत्रौ तत्रोषतुः सुखम्॥
en: Once on a time desirous of an interview with him, the Rishis entered his palace. Being duly adored by him, they continued to live there happily.

sa: मयैव यानि कर्माणि पूर्वदेहे तु मूढया। कृतानि नूनं पापानि तेषामेतत् फलं ध्रुवम्॥
en: The deeds that had been done by me in a previous life out of folly are certainly misdeeds and this is surely the result of that.

sa: रक्षमाणाश्च तं संख्ये ये मां योत्स्यन्ति केचन। अपि द्रोणकृपौ राजन् छादयिष्यामि ताञ्छरैः॥
en: Desirous of protecting him in battle whosoever shall fight with me, I will cover him, O king, with my arrows, be he Drona himself or Kripa.

sa: क्रोधो बलं तथा वीर्यं ज्ञानयोगोऽस्त्रलाघवम्। इह ते दृश्यतां पार्थं युद्ध्यस्व पुरुषो भव॥
en: Wrath, strength, prowess, knowledge, application and quickness in the handling of weapons, show these now and fight, O son of Pritha, and act like a man.

sa: हृष्टाश्च बहवो योधास्तत्राजल्पन्त वेगतः॥ न हि कर्णे रणे दृष्ट्वा युधि स्थास्यान्ति पाण्डवाः।
en: Numerous warriors, highly delighted, forming into groups, thus began to talk, “Surely the Pandavas, seeing Karna in the field, will not stay a while in battle.

sa: न चास्माशरणं गच्छेत् कृष्णं वा पुरुषोत्तमम्। भवन्तं वा महाराज श्वोऽस्मि हन्ता जयद्रथम्॥
en: Or seek our refuge or that of Krishna the foremost of all male being or that of yourself, O monarch. I will surely slay Jayadratha tomorrow.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो भृशं क्रुद्धो निर्विद्धं प्रेक्ष्य माधवम्॥ सारथिं कुरुवृद्धस्य निर्बिभेद शितैः शरैः। यतमानौ त तौ वीरावन्योन्यस्य वधं प्रति॥ न शक्नुतां तदाऽन्योन्यमभिसंधातुमाहवे। तौ मण्डलानि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च॥ अदर्शयेतां बहुधा सूतसामर्थ्यलाघवात्। अन्तरं च प्रहारेषु तर्कयन्तौ परस्परम्॥ राजन्नन्तरमार्गस्थौ स्थितावास्तां मुहुर्मुहुः। उभौ सिंहरवोन्मित्रं शङ्खशब्दं च चक्रतुः॥
en: Then seeing Madhava thus pierced, Arjuna wounded the charioteer of the son of Ganga with three arrows. Trying to strike each other's charioteers, they could not take aim at each other in that fight. O king, for the great ability and dexterity of the charioteers of both those warriors, their cars made beautiful circle by advancing and retreating. O king, seeking opportunity to strike each other, they often changed their positions to take aim at each other. Both of them blew their conchs and often sent forth lion-like roars.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च मृदङ्गाश्चानकैः सह। प्रावाद्यन्त महाराज पाण्डवानां निवेशने॥ सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। धनुातलशब्दश्च गगनस्पृक् सुभैरवः॥
en: There arose also loud shouts, like the roar of lions, uttered by the high-souled Pandavas; and the deafening sound resulting from the twang of their bow-strings and the striking of their palms against their arīns, reached the very skies.

sa: किं ते विवक्षया वीर जहि भीष्मं महारथम्। न ह्यन्यमनुपश्यामि कञ्चिद् यौधिष्ठिरे बले॥
en: What is that you want to speak, O hero? Slay the mighty car-warrior Bhishma, I do not see a man in the whole army of Yudhishthira,

sa: सभामध्ये च यद् रूपं मायया कृतवानसि। तत् तथैव पुनः कृत्वा सार्जुनो मामभिद्रव॥
en: The form in which you showed yourself in the midst of the assembly by the help of illusion, assuming again, come against me along with Arjuna.

sa: श्रुतं वाक्यं गृहीतोऽर्थो मतं यत् ते तथास्तु तत्। भीमसेनस्ततो वाक्यं भूय आह नृपात्मजम्॥ उलूक मद्वचो ब्रूहि दुर्मति पापपूरुषम्।
en: Your words have been heard by us and their sense accepted; let it be as you wish.” Then did Bhimasena, that son of a king, again say O Uluka, tell my words to that wicked man of sinful intellect.

sa: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया। मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते॥
en: The Illusion of Mine, developed from the said three qualities is marvelous and difficult to transcend. Those, that resort to Me alone, cross beyond this illusion.

sa: संजय उवाच तां प्रभग्नां चमूं दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रेणामितौजसा। दुर्योधनो भृशं क्रुद्धः स्वयं सौभद्रमभ्यतात्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then beholding his army routed Subhadra's son of immeasurable energy, king Duryodhana worked up the highest pitch of fury, himself proceeded against the former

sa: यस्य चैते वयं गेहे उषिता ब्रह्मवादिनः। आविक्षितं मरुत्तं च मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम॥
en: Although we the reciters of the sacre. Veda live under your roof. O Srinjaya, we had ) hear of the death of even Avikshita's son Marutta.

sa: तव भ्राता मम सखा सम्बन्धी शिष्य एव च। मांसान्युत्कृत्य दास्यामि फाल्गुनार्थे महीपते॥
en: Your brother, Arjuna, is my friend, relative and pupil; O ruler of earth, I can cut off and give away my own flesh for Arjuna's sake.

sa: श्रूयते सोऽद्य न तथा केकयानां च वेश्मसु। नित्यं प्रमुदितानां च तालगीतस्वनो महान्॥
en: Could no longer be heard the sound that used to be made by the songs and slappings of palms of soldiers engaged in dance and merrymaking.

sa: अस्त्रस्यास्य प्रभावाद् वै व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः। इतयुक्त्वा वरुणः प्रादाद् गदां मत्रपुरुकृताम्॥
en: By virtue of this weapon; so let the fever corroding your heart he dismissed.” Having thus spoken, Varuna gave him a mace with all necessary aphorisms.

sa: द्रोण उवाच यदि मां नाभिगच्छेया युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय सर्वशः॥
en: Drona said O king, if having resolved to fight, you filled to have come to me, I would have cursed you for bringing about your defeat.

sa: य एतां वेद गायत्री पुण्यां सर्वगुणान्विताम्। तत्त्वेन भरतश्रेष्ठ स लोके न प्रणश्यति॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, he who knows these to be the true sacred Gayatri which possesses every virtue, is not liable to worldly destruction.

sa: सत्यव्रतं च सप्तत्या विद्ध्वा शक्रसमो युधि। नृत्यन्निव रणे वीर आर्तिं नः समजीजनत्॥
en: And that heroic one equal to Shakra himself in battle, piercing Satyavrata with seventy shafts, seemed to dance about on the field causing us much pain,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच आर्जुनि समरे शूरं विनिघ्नन्तं महारथान्। अलम्बुषः कथं युद्धे प्रत्ययुध्यत संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How, O descendant of the Bharata race, did Alambusha fight with the heroic son of Arjuna who had been slaying mighty car-warriors in battle?

sa: आरोह स्यन्दनं वीर कवचं च महाभुजा बधान समरे राम यदि यो« मयेच्छसि॥
en: Mount on a chariot, O hero, and adjust your coat of mail, O you of long arms if, O Rama, you desire to fight with me.

sa: ततो मामब्रवीद् रामः स्मयमानो रणाजिरे। रथो मे मेदिनी भीष्म वाहा वेदाः सदश्ववत्॥
en: Then did Rama say to me laughingly in the field of battle: "The earth is chariot, O Bhishma, and the Vedas carry me like good horses.

sa: भीष्य उवाच ततः शिखण्डिनो माता यथातत्त्वं नराधिप। आचचक्षे महाबाहो भर्ने कन्यां शिखण्डिनीम्॥
en: Bhishma said The mother of Shikhandin, O mightyarmed ruler of men, related to her husband all about her daughter Shikhandin in accordance with the real facts.

sa: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितॄन् यान्ति पितृव्रताः। भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्॥
en: Those who worship the Pitris, go to the Pitris, those who worship the Bhutas, go to the Bhutas, but those who worship Me, come to Me.

sa: एको विष्णुरिवाचिन्त्यं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। तथा निर्मथितं तेन त्र्यहं तव बलं महत्॥
en: Achieving, single-handed, these mosi difficult of feats, like the incomprehensible Vishnu in the days of old, Abhimanyu crushed your army consisting of three kinds of forces.

sa: ब्रह्मण्यता दमो दानं तपश्च चरितं महत्। इहैव दृश्यते पार्थे भ्राता यस्य धनंजयः॥
en: Devotion to the Brahmanas, self control, benevolence, asceticism, and laudable good conduct-these are to be found in that king only who owns for his brothers Dhananjaya.

sa: सर्वतो मदम्। स नाग इव नागेन गोवृषेणेव गोवृषः। समाहूतः स्वयं राज्ञा नागानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Like an elephant challenged by another or like a bovine bull summoned by a rival, Bhimasena, challenged by the king himself, rushed against that elephant division.

sa: अयं पार्थः कुत पार्थ एष पार्थ इति प्रभो। तव सैन्येषु योधानां पार्थभूतमिवाभवत्॥
en: 'This is Arjuna' 'Where is Partha' 'Here is Pritha's son'-0 master, even thus were the troops of your army then filled with the thought of Partha.

sa: ततः सरसहस्रेण सौभद्रं प्रपितामहः। अवाकिरदमेयात्मा तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: The high-souled great grandsire (Bhishma) then covered Subhadra's son with thousands of arrows.

sa: नद्यः पुण्यजलास्तत्र गङ्गा च बहुधा गता॥ सुकुमारी कुमारी च शीताशी वेणिका तथा।
en: The rivers there are all full of sacred water. Ganga herself, distributed as she is in various countries, is also there. Sukumari, Kumari, Shitashi and Venika.

sa: शक्तस्त्वं हि रणे जेतुं ससुरासुरमानुषान्। त्रील्लोकान् समरे युक्तान् किं पुनः कौरवं बलम्॥८
en: What need I speak of defeating the Kauravas? Single-handed you can vanquish in battle the Asuras, celestials and human beings of the three worlds put together.

sa: योऽयं शल्य भरतेषूपपन्नः प्रकर्षणः सर्वहरोऽतिभीमः। सोऽभिमन्ये क्षत्रियाणां प्रवीरान् प्रतापिता बलवान् वै विमर्दः॥
en: O Shalya, that descendant of Bharatas who is highly dreadful, the destroyer of all the grinders of foes and powerful, will, me-thinks, grind many Kshatriya heroes.
